/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Ava.descriptionEn: The unseemly marriage of a Corpus sentry turret and a Sentient drone, this unit alternates between repeating energy bolts and a devastating focused beam weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Ava.descriptionZh: Corpus 哨兵炮台和 Sentient 无人机的看似不适宜的结合，这个单位可以在连续发射能量弹和毁灭性的聚焦光束间切换使用。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Ava.name: /Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/AmalgamPilotName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Ava.descriptionEn: Alad V has married countless generations of Sentient evolution with the most advanced Corpus technology to create a brutal, persistent fighter. Wields a plasma bullet assault rifle and carries an Amalgam Osprey into battle.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Ava.descriptionZh: 阿拉德 V 运用极其先进的 Corpus 技术，结合了无数 Sentient 世代的演化后创造出这款残酷坚毅的战士。配戴电浆突击步枪并携带并合鱼鹰投身战场。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Ava.descriptionEn: The full realization of the grotesque partnership between Alad V and the Sentients. This unit can upgrade organic allies by capturing them and birthing neuro-carnivorous memes directly into their brain stems, thereby super-charging their fighting capacity and resilience.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Ava.descriptionZh: 完全实现阿拉德 V 与 Sentient 之间的怪诞伙伴关系。这个作战单位可以抓住盟友并将神经食肉模因植入其脑干，从而为其战斗能力和恢复能力进行超级充能。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Ava.name: /Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/AmalgamSniperName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Ava.descriptionEn: An amalgamation of a Corpus Sniper and unknown sentient form. Not only is this fighter capable of pinpoint accuracy it can also manipulate matter to create a Spectralyst clone of any enemy, including Tenno.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Ava.name: /Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/AmalgamMoaSatyrName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Ava.descriptionEn: A diabolical mess of limbs, this Amalgam fighter doesn’t care which way is up. A fast-galloping unit that attacks with crushing melee blows, a repeater cannon and destabilizing ground slams.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Ava.descriptionZh: 它有着恶魔般的混乱四肢，这个并合战士不关心哪个方向是向上的。这是一种迅速疾驰的作战部队，使用毁灭性的近战肉搏、连发式加农炮和失衡震地重击进行攻击。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Ava.name: /Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/AmalgamDroneName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Ava.descriptionEn: Corpus Osprey and Armored Sentient, conjoined in a hideous fusion of known and unknown to create a lethal unit that attacks with conventional beam weapons, or clones nearby friendly units to create Spectralyst fighters.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Ava.descriptionZh: Corpus 鱼鹰和装甲 Sentient，以已知和未知的丑陋融合方式结合起来，创造出一种致命的作战单位。它可以用常规光束武器攻击，或者克隆附近的友军来创造出幽魅使战士。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Ava.name: /Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/AmalgamGhostName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Ava.descriptionEn: A transient copy of an ally or enemy created by a Sentient from Tau energy.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Ava.descriptionZh: Sentient 借由 Tau 能量创造出的友军/敌人复制品。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Ava.name: /Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/AmalgamSpectralystBoss
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Ava.descriptionEn: A transient copy of an ally or enemy created by a Sentient from Tau energy.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Ava.descriptionZh: Sentient 借由 Tau 能量创造出的友军/敌人复制品。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Ava.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/CarrusPilotName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Ava.descriptionEn: A specialist in synthetic metallurgy protected by a large shield wall. This Corpus Tech brandishes a razor-torch hot enough to melt Sentient armor and is capable of rapid regeneration. Summons a Mine Osprey.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Ava.descriptionZh: 合成冶金专家，由大型盾牆保护。这名 Corpus 技师挥舞着一把火炬焊枪，足以融化 Sentient 装甲，能够快速再生。可以召唤地雷鱼鹰。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Pro.name: /Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/PrototypeCarrusName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Pro.descriptionEn: The unseemly marriage of a Corpus sentry turret and Sentient drone, this unit alternates between Arca Plasmor blasts and a devastating focused beam weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Pro.descriptionZh: Corpus 哨卫炮台和 Sentient 无人机的诡异结合产物。该单位能够切换使用弧电离子枪或是聚焦光束武器来发动攻击。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Pro.name: /Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/PrototypeAmalgamCarrusPilotName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Pro.descriptionEn: Alad V has married countless generations of Sentient evolution with the most advanced Corpus technology to create a brutal, persistent fighter. Wields a razor-torch hot enough to melt Sentient armor and is capable of rapid regeneration.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Pro.descriptionZh: 阿拉德 V 让无数代 Sentient 进化产物与最先进的 Corpus 技术结合，从而造就出了这样一个野蛮而强韧的战士。该单位不仅拥有能将 Sentient 护甲熔穿的火炬焊枪，还能快速再生。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Pro.name: /Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/PrototypeMeleeName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Pro.descriptionEn: An amalgamation of a Corpus brute and unknown sentient form. Not only is this fighter capable of crushing blows it can also manipulate matter to create a Spectralyst clone of any enemy, including Tenno
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Pro.descriptionZh: 一种强大的 Corpus 单位与某种未知的 Sentient 单位的并合体。这位战士不仅能将目标打得粉碎，还能操纵物质，制造出一个以任何敌人为原型的瞬态使复制体，就连 Tenno 也不例外。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Pro.name: /Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/PrototypeMoaName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Pro.descriptionEn: A lethal blend of Corpus ingenuity and Sentient technology, this MOA shares the out-of-phase healing mode with its Prototype cousin but is also capable of staggering opponents with globes of explosive Sentient energy.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Pro.descriptionZh: Corpus 独创性和 Sentient 技术的致命混合体，这只恐鸟与它的原型表亲一样有着自愈模式而且备有爆炸性的 Sentient 能量护罩可以打断对手的行动。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Pro.name: /Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/PrototypeSatyrName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Pro.descriptionEn: A diabolical mess of limbs, this Amalgam fighter doesn’t care which way is up. A fast-galloping unit that attacks with crushing melee blows, destabilizing ground slams and homing energy projectiles.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Pro.descriptionZh: 它有着恶魔般的混乱四肢，这名并合战士不关心哪个方向是向上的。该单位能迅速疾驰，并使用毁灭性的近战肉搏、失衡震地重击和追踪型能量弹进行攻击。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Aristocrats/.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/AristocratManagerName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Aristocrats/.descriptionEn: One of Parvos' favored, keeper of the tokens of his esteem.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Aristocrats/.descriptionZh: 帕尔沃斯的宠臣之一，掌管着象征他尊严的代币。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/BipedRobot/A.descriptionEn: Facilitates weapon testing for the Jackal.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/BipedRobot/A.name: /Lotus/Language/Game/ControlRiotMoaName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/BipedRobot/A.descriptionEn: Corrals its prey for rapid destruction
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/BipedRobot/A.descriptionZh: 削弱它的猎物以求迅速破坏

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/BipedRobot/A.name: /Lotus/Language/Game/PreventionRiotMoaName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/BipedRobot/A.descriptionEn: Blocks choke points to protect objectives
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/BipedRobot/A.descriptionZh: 挡住要点通路以守护目标

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Narmer/Avata.descriptionEn: The unseemly marriage of a Corpus sentry turret and a Sentient drone, this unit alternates between repeating energy bolts and a devastating focused beam weapon.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Narmer/Avata.descriptionEn: Alad V has married countless generations of Sentient evolution with the most advanced Corpus technology to create a brutal, persistent fighter. Wields a plasma bullet assault rifle and carries an Amalgam Osprey into battle.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Narmer/Avata.descriptionZh: 阿拉德 V 运用极其先进的 Corpus 技术，结合了无数 Sentient 世代的演化后创造出这款残酷坚毅的战士。配戴电浆突击步枪并携带并合鱼鹰投身战场。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Narmer/Avata.name: /Lotus/Language/CorpusGasCity/AmalgamOverrideName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Narmer/Avata.descriptionEn: The full realization of the grotesque partnership between Alad V and the Sentients. This unit can upgrade organic allies by capturing them and birthing neuro-carnivorous memes directly into their brain stems, thereby super-charging their fighting capacity and resilience.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Narmer/Avata.descriptionZh: 完全实现阿拉德 V 与 Sentient 之间的怪诞伙伴关系。这个作战单位可以抓住盟友并将神经食肉模因植入其脑干，从而为其战斗能力和恢复能力进行超级充能。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Narmer/Avata.descriptionEn: An amalgamation of a Corpus Sniper and unknown sentient form. Not only is this fighter capable of pinpoint accuracy it can also manipulate matter to create a Spectralyst clone of any enemy, including Tenno.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Comman.descriptionZh: 升华实验室的 Sentient 研究主管。已被奈富·安尤所委托逆向工程来恢复 Sentient 技术的一号人物。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Heavie.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusHyenaAstro
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Heavie.descriptionEn: Usually found in the Orb Vallis, this Hyena model lobs ice grenades and fires electric bolts.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Heavie.descriptionZh: 通常在奥布山谷中被找到，这种鬣狗型号抛出冰冻手雷，并发射电击射钉。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Heavie.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusHyenaBurner
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Heavie.descriptionEn: This Hyena has been heavily modified to fire its spines as guided projectiles.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Heavie.descriptionZh: 这种鬣狗被大幅地调整，可以发射出制导的锥刺。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Heavie.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusHyenaHotrod
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Heavie.descriptionEn: Scatters tether mines with its spin attack, or lays down automatic fire with its cannon.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Heavie.descriptionZh: 通过旋转攻击四散出牵引地雷，或者用大炮对准目标射出全自动火力。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Heavie.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusHyenaPacer
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Heavie.descriptionEn: This ruthless Hyena variant pounds foes with its mortar attack and then finishes them off with flaming rounds.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Heavie.descriptionZh: 这种无情的鬣狗变种用迫击炮重击敌人，并用燃烧弹终结他们。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Vip/Av.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusVipShotgunSpacemanName

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Ambulas/.descriptionZh: 将精英部队投送至纷争区域的强化秃鹫飞船。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Ambulas/.descriptionZh: 修复瘫痪的智踱恐鸟单位

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Ambulas/.name: /Lotus/Language/Game/BossAmbulas
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Ambulas/.descriptionEn: This reborn Ambulas has been upgraded to become one of most lethal combat proxies.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Ambulas/.descriptionZh: 这台重生后的智踱恐鸟已被升级为最致命的战斗代行机械。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CamperSpiderName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.descriptionEn: Monster of the Vallis and protector of Enrichment Labs, this massive Orb appears to be invulnerable.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.descriptionZh: 山谷中的怪物以及升华实验室的保护者，这只巨大的圆蛛似乎是无敌的。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/TerraSpiderName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.descriptionEn: Exploiter harvests energy from the landscape and uses storms of ice and snow to safeguard the Temple of Profit from trespassers.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.descriptionZh: 剥削者从地貌中收割能量，并使用冰雪风暴来保护润盈殿免受入侵者的破坏。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/TerraSpiderName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.descriptionEn: Exploiter harvests energy from the landscape and uses storms of ice and snow to safeguard the Temple of Profit from trespassers.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.descriptionZh: 剥削者从地貌中收割能量，并使用冰雪风暴来保护润盈殿免受入侵者的破坏。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/CoolantSpiderName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.descriptionEn: Often found near the Exploiter Orb, these Raknoids carry deep-ice coolant that they use to protect themselves while harvesting Thermia fractures.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.descriptionZh: 通常可以在剥削者圆蛛附近找到，这些蛛形机在收割热美亚裂缝时会携带深冰冷却液来保护自己。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/HungerSpiderName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.descriptionEn: This mid-sized Raknoid is highly mobile and attacks by latching onto prey with a grappling hook or spitting deadly fluid from its sac.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.descriptionZh: 这只中型蛛形机具高度机动性，并可以通过擒抱钩锁或从其囊中吐出致命的液体来锁定猎物。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MicroSpiderName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.descriptionEn: This diminutive Raknoid burrows into the Vallis permafrost and patiently waits in ambush for approaching enemies.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.descriptionZh: 这个微型的蛛形机潜入山谷永久冻土带并耐心等待，埋伏所靠近的敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/MicroMoltenSpiderName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.descriptionEn: Quick and deadly, these Raknoids attack with heat and flame.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.descriptionZh: 快速而又致命，这些蛛形机会用热量和火焰来进行攻击。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/WrathSpiderName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.descriptionEn: A large Raknoid, with multiple attack vectors that is most frequently deployed during high alert levels.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.descriptionZh: 巨型的蛛形机，具有多个攻击向量，在高警戒级别期间最常被部署。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.name: /Lotus/Language/Veilbreaker/HungerSpiderName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.descriptionEn: This mid-sized Raknoid is highly mobile and attacks by latching onto prey with a grappling hook or spitting deadly fluid from its sac.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Hyena/Hy.descriptionZh: 具有能量抽取和界面元素的干扰光环的蓄力攻击

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Hyena/Hy.descriptionZh: 远程攻击，护盾恢复光环

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Hyena/Hy.name: /Lotus/Language/Game/HyenaIceName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Hyena/Hy.descriptionEn: Strong Melee attacks with a Slow Aura
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Hyena/Hy.descriptionZh: 强力近战攻击 缓速光环

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Zariman/Avat.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/CrpInterrupterName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Zariman/Avat.descriptionEn: Using the latest in Corpus weapons technology, this Crewman absorbs damage, until it unleashes it all in a powerful shockwave. The Derivator unit is mounted on the back.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Zariman/Avat.descriptionZh: 使用了最新的 Corpus 武器技术，这种船员可持续吸收伤害并一次性将受到的伤害以强大的冲击波形式释放出来。引能单位安装在该船员的背部。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.name: /Lotus/Language/Game/CorpusArtificerSentinel
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.descriptionEn: Charges its target and detonates when threatened
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.descriptionZh: 当自身受到威胁时会冲向目标并自爆。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corrupted/Avatars/C.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/CorruptedBeastMasterName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corrupted/Avatars/C.descriptionEn: He came in search of Void treasure, the Orokin Neural Sentry had other plans.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corrupted/Avatars/C.descriptionZh: 他来寻求虚空的宝藏，奥罗金的神经哨卫却另有打算。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corrupted/Avatars/C.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/CorruptedCombatKubrowName

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corrupted/Avatars/C.descriptionZh: 奥罗金神经哨卫现已控制这只野兽。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Duviri/PaxDuviricus.name: /Lotus/Language/Suits/PaxDuviricusFrameName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Duviri/PaxDuviricus.descriptionEn: Kullervo answers for his sins and the sins of others. His daggers and melee prowess deal high damage. Seize the power of treachery to slake his thirst for revenge.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Duviri/PaxDuviricus.descriptionZh: Kullervo 背负着自己和他人的罪孽。他的匕首和近战能力可以造成高额伤害。抓住背叛的力量来满足他对复仇的渴望。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Entrati/Doppelgange.name: /Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGeneral/EntratiDoppelgangerMeleeName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Entrati/Doppelgange.descriptionEn: This mocking phantom emerges to persecute the one who unwisely looked into its book, cutting deeply with hatred and blows alike. The book it arose from is its one vulnerability.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Entrati/Doppelgange.descriptionZh: 这个嘲讽幻影会显现并纠缠草率地翻看这本书的人，通过仇恨和猛击造成伤害。产生它的那本书是它的唯一弱点。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Entrati/Doppelgange.name: /Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGeneral/EntratiDoppelgangerRangedName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Entrati/Doppelgange.descriptionEn: Looking too deeply into Albrecht's lost grimoires may cause a void-born duplicate to appear, seething with contempt for the one who let it loose and hurling its wrath from afar. It cannot be banished until the book that gave rise to it is destroyed.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Entrati/Doppelgange.descriptionZh: 对阿尔布雷希特的遗失魔典研究过深，可能会导致出现一个从虚空诞生的副本，对释放它的人充满蔑视，它的愤怒从远端汹涌而至。除非产生它的那本魔典被摧毁，否则无法驱逐它。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Ghou.name: /Lotus/Language/Game/GhoulDevourer
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Ghou.descriptionEn:
Vay Hek's personal favorite, the Devourer is a maximal terror unit. Draped in shreds of the diapause bag that birthed it, this gap-mawed monstrosity barrels toward prey with furious intensity.

Wrist-mounted hooks are welded to elbow joints and hyperpowered by a myotechnological winch system for maximum impact-and-pull.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Ghou.descriptionZh:
身为韦·海克最爱的作战单位，吞噬者是极为恐怖的存在。那些孕育出他们的休眠袋，现已化为残片，悬挂在他们身上。这种长着血盆大口的怪物会以自己的身体为武器，向猎物发起猛烈冲锋。

配备在他们腰部的钩爪机关已与其肘关节焊死，并且搭配了由肌肉控制的绞索驱动系统，使其冲击与牵引力均可达到极致。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Ghou.name: /Lotus/Language/Game/GhoulDrill
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Ghou.descriptionEn:
Known colloquially as the 'drill sergeant', the Auger is fast-grown into its enhancements. As with all Ghouls, no regard is given to the proper development of its higher functions.

Cantilevered leg augments propel the unit toward the fray at speed, while over- and under-mounted extendable drill carriages magnify both reach and penetrating power.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Ghou.descriptionZh:
被俗称为"钻头中士"，钻孔者快速地长入它的增幅装备。同其他所有尸鬼一样，并没有人在意它高级功能的正常发育。

悬臂式的腿部增强装置可以快速地将该单位推入战斗，而上下悬挂的可延展钻头车放大了攻击范围和穿透力。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Ghou.name: /Lotus/Language/Game/GhoulExpired
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Ghou.descriptionEn: The Expired are Ghouls who have succumbed to malnutrition or environmental poisoning during the early stages of development. Their backup nervous systems continue to drive them forward, however, making them ideal suicide troops.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Ghou.descriptionZh: 除役者是在早期发育阶段营养不良或者受环境毒素影响的尸鬼。它们备用的神经系统继续驱使着它们前进，因此，它们是理想的自杀部队。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Ghou.name: /Lotus/Language/Game/GhoulSawman
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Ghou.descriptionEn: So named for its terrifying leer, the Rictus (AKA 'the Sawman') lives to divide and conquer its foes - literally.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Ghou.descriptionZh: 因它恐怖的邪笑而得名，裂嘴者（也就是"电锯兵"）生来就是为了将敌人分而治之——字面意义上的分而治之。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Vip/.name: /Lotus/Language/Game/GhoulDrillVip
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Vip/.descriptionEn: Whether through aberrant cognition or sheer brutality one specimen always moves to the front of each pack. It is from this individual that the other units take their lead.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Vip/.descriptionZh: 不管是因为异常的认知能力还是单纯的残暴，总有一个样本会移动到每一群尸鬼的前列。其他的单位以这个样本为引领。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Vip/.name: /Lotus/Language/Game/CorpusArtificerSentinel
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Vip/.descriptionEn: Charges its target and detonates when threatened
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Vip/.descriptionZh: 当自身受到威胁时会冲向目标并自爆。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Vip/.name: /Lotus/Language/Game/GhoulSawmanVip
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Vip/.descriptionEn: This specimen shows evidence of advanced cognitive abilities and greater, if rudimentary, situational analysis. Cold blooded and ruthless, it is easy to see how this specimen led its pack so ably.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Ghouls/Vip/.descriptionZh: 这个样本显示出了高级的认知能力，以及更强的、尽管初等的情景分析能力。冷血而又无情，可以轻易地明白这个样本是如何巧妙地引导它的群落的。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Emi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/AncientShellName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Emi.descriptionEn: The cunning Therid uses its long arms to spin a ball of corrosive gossamer that it hurls with surprising force. It has also been known to scoop up smaller infested to throw at intruders as an improvised projectile/delivery system.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Emi.descriptionZh: 狡猾的古壳蛛用它的长臂卷出一团腐蚀性的蛛丝，并以惊人的力量投掷出去。此外，它还会就地取材，把较小的感染者当作投射物来抛向入侵者。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Emi.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/AncientTankName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Emi.descriptionEn: An ancient brute possessed of a weighty arm-flail and the terrifying strength to use it to devastating effect. Its lumbering form belies shocking speed, which the Leaping Thrasher achieves by slamming its arm into the ground and throwing itself into battle.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Emi.descriptionZh: 一个古老的野兽，拥有沉重的连枷和可怕的力量来使用它达到毁灭性的效果。它笨重的身体掩盖了惊人的速度，这是鞭击奔跳者通过将手臂猛撞到地面并将自身投入战场来实现的。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Emi.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/InfestedJetpackName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Emi.descriptionEn: An Infested jetpack trooper, the Undying Flyer rams opponents at high speed. When killed it reverts to a pod-state. If not destroyed the Undying Flyer emerges at full health.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Emi.descriptionZh: 一个感染者喷气伞兵，不死飞行者通过高速撞击来攻击对手。当它被杀死时，它会恢复到一种茧的状态。如果它没有被彻底摧毁，不死飞行者将以生命值全满的状态浮现。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Gre.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/BoneBladeAgentName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Gre.descriptionEn: A writhing tower of flesh and gristle, the Jugulus lurks beneath the surface and emerges to launch streams of organic projectiles from its wide maw.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Gre.descriptionZh: 一只由肉体和软骨构成且会扭动的塔形生物，喉骨刃者潜伏在地表之下，伺机现身来从它的大嘴里发射出一连串有机弹丸。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Run.descriptionZh: 快速，使用威力较弱的利爪攻击

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Run.name: /Lotus/Language/Game/InfestedSuicideRunner
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Run.descriptionEn: Fast and explodes when near enemies
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Run.descriptionZh: 快速接近并在敌人附近自爆

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Wea.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/WeaveDecodeName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Wea.descriptionEn: A subordinate loyal to the Zealoid Prelate, the Bastion renders regular Infested invulnerable.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Wea.descriptionZh: 作为忠于狂热主教的下属，护卫使得普通的感染者无懈可击。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Wea.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/WeaveMutalistName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Wea.descriptionEn: Wreathed in an obfuscating black cloud the Zealoid Prelate brings Arlo's word with fire, blood and loyal Bastions who spring to his aid.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Wea.descriptionZh: 缭绕在一团黑色的迷云中，狂热主教将战火、鲜血以及有求于他的忠实护卫们带到 Arlo 的世界。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/Disruption.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/DisruptionInfestedTankName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/Disruption.descriptionEn: Demolishers are explosive enemies with a single-minded purpose: the destruction of compromised conduits at any cost. Part of the complete Alad V Conduit Security Package!
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/Disruption.descriptionZh: 爆破型是具有单一目的的爆炸性敌人：不惜任何代价破坏受损导管。这是阿拉德 V 完整的导管安全套装的一部分！

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/AncientTankMicroPlanetName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: An ancient brute possessed of a weighty arm-flail and the terrifying strength to use it to devastating effect. Its lumbering form belies shocking speed, which the Leaping Thrasher achieves by slamming its arm into the ground and throwing itself into battle.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 一个古老的野兽，拥有沉重的连枷和可怕的力量来使用它达到毁灭性的效果。它笨重的身体掩盖了惊人的速度，这是鞭击奔跳者通过将手臂猛撞到地面并将自身投入战场来实现的。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/AncientTankMicroPlanetName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: An ancient brute possessed of a weighty arm-flail and the terrifying strength to use it to devastating effect. Its lumbering form belies shocking speed, which the Leaping Thrasher achieves by slamming its arm into the ground and throwing itself into battle.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 一个古老的野兽，拥有沉重的连枷和可怕的力量来使用它达到毁灭性的效果。它笨重的身体掩盖了惊人的速度，这是鞭击奔跳者通过将手臂猛撞到地面并将自身投入战场来实现的。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/AshenAgentName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: Carnis are many-legged hunters, ferocious and ever-hungry. They scuttle just out of reach trying to wear down their prey with ranged attacks until they can rush in to consume it.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 肉碾虫是凶猛且饥渴的多腿猎手。它们疾速与目标拉开距离，并试图通过远程攻击来拖垮它们的猎物，直到它们能冲上去享用美餐。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/AshenBigAgentName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: The Carnis Rex is a true terror, a monstrously-large Carnis. The Carnis Rex rushes headlong upon their prey, often coiling into a spinning wheel in its haste to come to grips.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 肉碾王虫是一种真正的恐怖，一种巨型肉碾虫。肉碾王虫会迅猛扑向它们的猎物，常常迅速缠绕上去并翻滚旋转，以此来对付它们的猎物。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/AshenAgentName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: Carnis are many-legged hunters, ferocious and ever-hungry. They scuttle just out of reach trying to wear down their prey with ranged attacks until they can rush in to consume it.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 肉碾虫是凶猛且饥渴的多腿猎手。它们疾速与目标拉开距离，并试图通过远程攻击来拖垮它们的猎物，直到它们能冲上去享用美餐。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/CellCarrierDroneMicroPlanetName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: Carries energy cells
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 运输能量核心

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/DeployableSpacemanResearcherName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: Marooned Corpus researcher, unwilling resident on Deimos and ally-of-circumstance to the Entrati. Happy to see a non-Infested face.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 陷入困境而只能定居在火卫二的 Corpus 研究员，受制于环境成为英择谛的盟友。对于看到一张不属于感染者的面孔感到很高兴。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/DiseasedAncientMicroPlanetName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: Spawns maggots that attack its target
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 孵化蛆虫攻击它的目标

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/DiseasedAncientMicroPlanetName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: Spawns maggots that attack its target
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 孵化蛆虫攻击它的目标

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/InfestedTendrilDroneName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: An infested drone as brutal and unforgiving as Deimos itself.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 一架感染者的无人机，就像火卫二本身一样残暴无情。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/InfestedTendrilDroneName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: An infested drone as brutal and unforgiving as Deimos itself.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 一架感染者的无人机，就像火卫二本身一样残暴无情。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/InfestedBigDropshipName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: Genetrix act as mobile wombs for the Infested hordes, discharging swarms of Infested whenever they detect a non-Infested intruder. A Genetrix prominent sensor stalk must be disabled or avoided to stem a seemingly unending tide of monsters.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 母艇作为感染者大军的移动巢穴，每当其探测到非感染者的入侵者时，便会释放出成群的感染者。只有避开母艇上突出的感应柄或让其失效，才能阻止这看似永无止境的怪物浪潮。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/DeimosAssassinationTargetFemurName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: Saxum Rex are larger, meaner Saxum and represent a considerably enhanced threat. How they achieve this evolution is unknown, but cannibalism is suspected.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 重岩王者是体型更大、更凶猛的重岩者，是一种相当大的威胁。现在尚未清楚它们是如何实现这种进化的，但有可能是通过同类相食。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/HealingAncientMicroPlanetName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: Heavy melee unit that heals allies with pulses.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 重型近战单位，使用脉冲治疗其友军。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/HealingAncientMicroPlanetName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: Heavy melee unit that heals allies with pulses.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 重型近战单位，使用脉冲治疗其友军。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/InfestedAttackDroneMicroPlanetName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: Fires infested spores
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 发射被感染的孢子。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/InfestedAttackDroneMicroPlanetName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: Fires infested spores
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 发射被感染的孢子。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/JuggernautMicroPlanetName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: Protected by impenetrable armor
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 由无坚不摧的装甲所保护

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/JuggernautMicroPlanetName

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 由无坚不摧的装甲所保护

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/DynamicRuinsEscortName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: With the ability to track a scent from miles away, this Juggernaut is an invaluable ally when foraging rare Polyps from the ruins of Deimos
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 这只巨兽能够追踪远处的气味，在火卫二废墟中寻找罕见的息肉时，它是一位宝贵的友军。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/LeapingSuicideRunnerName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: Fast with a leap attack
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 快速和奔跳式攻击

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/LightningCrawlerMicroPlanetName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: Shocks nearby enemies with a bio-electrical attack
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 用生物电流攻击周遭敌人

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/MinigunBombardGrineerLeaderName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: Wily Grineer castaway, acclaimed as squad leader by his surviving brood-mates. Capable of complex diplomatic negotiations by Grineer standards.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 诡计多端的 Grineer 弃将，被他幸存的同批次克隆的战友们视作小队领袖。能以 Grineer 的标准进行复杂外交谈判。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/NaniteCloudBipedMicroPlanetName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: Discharges swarms of infested spores
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 喷出成群的感染孢子

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/NaniteCloudBipedMicroPlanetName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: Discharges swarms of infested spores
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 喷出成群的感染孢子

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/InfestedJetpackMicroPlanetName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: An Infested jetpack trooper, the Undying Flyer rams opponents at high speed. When killed it reverts to a pod-state. If not destroyed the Undying Flyer emerges at full health.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 一个感染者喷气伞兵，不死飞行者通过高速撞击来攻击对手。当它被杀死时，它会恢复到一种茧的状态。如果它没有被彻底摧毁，不死飞行者将以生命值全满的状态浮现。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/FiveFates/InfestedOniAgentName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: An Infested beast of considerable strength long rumored to be lying dormant in the muck off the shores of Cetus.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 据传，一种力量强大的感染野兽一直潜伏在希图斯海岸的淤泥中。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/QuadrupedMicroPlanetName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: Fast with weak claw attacks
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 快速，使用威力较弱的利爪攻击

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/QuadrupedMicroPlanetName

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 快速，使用威力较弱的利爪攻击

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 快速，使用威力较弱的利爪攻击

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/SplitterAgentName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: When pressured, this beast severs its torso from its legs, yielding double trouble for its victims.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 在受到压力时，这只野兽会把它的躯干和双腿分开，给受害者带来双重的麻烦。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/SplitterAgentName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: When pressured, this beast severs its torso from its legs, yielding double trouble for its victims.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 在受到压力时，这只野兽会把它的躯干和双腿分开，给受害者带来双重的麻烦。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/SplitterAgentVIPName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: Fiercely territorial, this beast lurks within the ruins of Deimos.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 这只潜伏在火卫二废墟中的野兽有着强烈的领地意识。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/SplitterBottomHalfName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: Deaf, dumb, and blind, it hunts prey using vibrations from the surrounding environment.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 缺乏听觉和视觉能力，它会利用周围环境的震动来猎杀目标。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/InfestedMicroplanet/SplitterTopHalfName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: Dismembered, but deadly nonetheless. Its acrobatic movement makes it threatening from any range.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: 虽被肢解但依然致命。它的杂耍动作使其在任何范围内都极具威胁

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/SpecialEve.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/ArloZealotDualSwordGunName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/SpecialEve.descriptionEn: Attacking with blade and gun, this Zealot spreads the ‘message' with a hive of toxic, explosive pustules that grow on his back when he is attacked.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/SpecialEve.descriptionZh: 这名狂热者使用刀刃与枪械攻击目标。而在受到攻击时，他会通过背上的一个带有引爆式毒液脓疱的巢囊来传播“消息”。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/SpecialEve.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/ArloZealotGunName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/SpecialEve.descriptionEn: This Zealot targets potential converts with a spray of toxic sludge.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/KuvaLich/KuvaLarvli.descriptionEn: Spiked with "The Old Blood". This Larvling seeks death by Tenno, and rebirth as a Kuva Lich.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/KuvaLich/KuvaLarvli.descriptionZh: 在接受了"远古之血"的改造后，这只幼体渴望被 Tenno 杀死，然后转生成为一个赤毒玄骸。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/ManInTheWall/Murmur.descriptionEn: The Unseeing Herald proclaims the will of the Indifference, uttering its twisted desires in Voidtongue. Who among us has heard its whispers?

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/ManInTheWall/Octope.descriptionEn: On the rare occasions when Murmur fragments assemble themselves into a whole, the result is a monstrous and potent entity. It may manifest in three different forms, the Suzerain, Zelator and Anchorite, with a fourth form, the 'Fragmented One', being the most formidable of all. Together, as heralds of the Indifference, they tether down the Strands of Khra down which their bizarre master must travel.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/ManInTheWall/Octope.descriptionZh: 在极少数情况下，低语者断肢会组合成一个整体。这种情况下会产生一个强大的怪物。它可能有三种不同的形态：宗主级、信徒级和隐士级，而第四种形态的"接肢至尊"则是其中最可怕的。作为虚空无情之物的使者，它们固定着时间丝线，而它们奇异的主人则必须沿着时间丝线才能前进。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/ManInTheWall/Repair.name: /Lotus/Language/Entrati/EntratiLabsRepairDroneName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/ManInTheWall/Repair.descriptionEn: These helpful Necramites have helped keep Albrecht Entrati's Laboratories in tip top shape while Loid and the Cavia were in stasis.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/ManInTheWall/Repair.descriptionZh: 当洛德和科维兽处于冷冻舱时，这些乐于助人的殁世微灵使阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的实验室保持在最佳状态。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/ManInTheWall/Treasu.name: /Lotus/Language/DanteUnbound/DisruptionLootGoblin
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/ManInTheWall/Treasu.descriptionEn: These greedy little Murmur tricksters love to steal Conduit Dockets and other coveted items from Albrecht's labs.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/ManInTheWall/Treasu.descriptionZh: 这些贪婪的低语者小调皮鬼喜欢从阿尔布雷希特的实验室偷取导管文卷和其他珍贵的物品。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Avatars.descriptionZh: 协助豺狼的武器测试。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.name: /Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoBaseCorpusVIPAgent
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.descriptionEn: Director of the Subterranean Armaments Division. Responsible for all research into weapons that can more effectively combat all things fungal.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.descriptionZh: 地下军备部门的主管。负责所有能够更有效地对抗真菌的武器的研究。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.name: /Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoBaseRaknoidVIPAgent
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.descriptionEn: A large Raknoid, with multiple attack vectors that is most frequently deployed during high alert levels.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.descriptionZh: 巨型的蛛形机，具有多个攻击向量，在高警戒级别期间最常被部署。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.name: /Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoColonyVIPAgentA
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.descriptionEn: Director of the Subterranean Demolitions Division. Responsible for carving out swathes of Venus's mines for Nef Anyo's personal use.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.descriptionZh: 地下爆破部门主管。负责在金星上开凿大片矿场，供奈富·安尤个人使用。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.name: /Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoColonyVIPAgentB
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.descriptionEn: Director of the Subterranean Strike Division. Responsible for coordinating attacks on targets that draw Nef Anyo's ire.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.descriptionZh: 地下打击部门主管。负责协调针对引起奈富·安尤愤怒的目标的攻击。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusHyenaAstro
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.descriptionEn: Usually found in the Orb Vallis, this Hyena model lobs ice grenades and fires electric bolts.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.descriptionZh: 通常在奥布山谷中被找到，这种鬣狗型号抛出冰冻手雷，并发射电击射钉。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusHyenaBurner
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.descriptionEn: This Hyena has been heavily modified to fire its spines as guided projectiles.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.descriptionZh: 这种鬣狗被大幅地调整，可以发射出制导的锥刺。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.name: /Lotus/Language/SolarisVenus/VenusHyenaPacer
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.descriptionEn: This ruthless Hyena variant pounds foes with its mortar attack and then finishes them off with flaming rounds.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.descriptionZh: 这种无情的鬣狗变种用迫击炮重击敌人，并用燃烧弹终结他们。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.name: /Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoLabVIPAgent
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.descriptionEn: Chief technology officer of the Subterranean Research Division. Responsible for researching Syzygy energy to the benefit of Nef Anyo.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.descriptionZh: 地下研究部首席技术官。负责研究朔望花能量，以造福奈富·安尤。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.name: /Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoPlantVIPAgent
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.descriptionEn: Often found near the Exploiter Orb, these Raknoids carry deep-ice coolant that they use to protect themselves while harvesting Thermia fractures.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Nok.descriptionZh: 通常可以在剥削者圆蛛附近找到，这些蛛形机在收割热美亚裂缝时会携带深冰冷却液来保护自己。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Tra.name: /Lotus/Language/NokkoColony/NokkoTrappedChestVIPAgent
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Tra.descriptionEn: Chief research officer of the Subterranean Energy Division. Responsible for producing new methods of energy production to fuel Nef Anyo's ambitions.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Vip/Tra.descriptionZh: 地下能源部首席研究官。负责研发新型能源生产技术，为奈富·安尤的野心提供动力。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/Gamemodes/Or.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/CorruptedPowerCarrier
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/Gamemodes/Or.descriptionEn: [PH] A Corrupted Lancer carrying a power cell
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/Gamemodes/Or.descriptionZh: [PH] A Corrupted Lancer carrying a power cell

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/OrokinHealin.name: /Lotus/Language/Game/CorruptedAncient
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/OrokinHealin.descriptionEn: Heavy melee unit that protects allies with Overguard, or damage reduction if Tenno
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/OrokinHealin.descriptionZh: 重型近战单位，通过超宏防护保护其友军，或减少 Tenno 造成的伤害

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/OrokinHealin.name: /Lotus/Language/Game/CorruptedAncient
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/OrokinHealin.descriptionEn: Heavy melee unit that protects allies with Overguard, or damage reduction if Tenno
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/OrokinHealin.descriptionZh: 重型近战单位，通过超宏防护保护其友军，或减少 Tenno 造成的伤害

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/OrokinNullif.name: /Lotus/Language/Game/OrokinNullifier
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/OrokinNullif.descriptionEn: Energy shield blocks projectiles and nullifies powers
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/OrokinNullif.descriptionZh: 能量护盾可以阻挡子弹并使能力无效化。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/OrokinNullif.name: /Lotus/Language/Game/OrokinNullifier
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/OrokinNullif.descriptionEn: Energy shield blocks projectiles and nullifies powers
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/OrokinNullif.descriptionZh: 能量护盾可以阻挡子弹并使能力无效化。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Quests/JadeShadowsP.name: /Lotus/Language/JadeShadowsPart2Mission/JS2MAshLightMelee
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Quests/JadeShadowsP.descriptionEn: Ryoku's fearsome Shadow Clones overwhelm his foes from the shadows.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Quests/JadeShadowsP.descriptionZh: 忍力恐怖的影分身潜行于阴影之中压制敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Quests/JadeShadowsP.name: /Lotus/Language/JadeShadowsPart2Mission/JS2MAshBoss
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Quests/JadeShadowsP.descriptionEn: Ryoku, the keen captain of Santovan's Oath, and the patron saint of assassins. With a sharp blade and sharper mind, his capital ship soars into combat with the Tenno, much to Hunhow's amusement.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Quests/JadeShadowsP.descriptionZh: 忍力是圣名者誓言号机敏果决的舰长，也是刺客的守护圣徒。凭借锋利的刀刃与更加锋锐的头脑，他驾驭主力舰与 Tenno 并肩杀入战斗，令 Hunhow 大为玩味。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Quests/JadeShadowsP.name: /Lotus/Language/JadeShadowsPart2Mission/JS2MGarudaBoss
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Quests/JadeShadowsP.descriptionEn: Vena, the deadly captain of the Kuva Wytch, commands your respect. Out of boredom, or perhaps for a sadistic love of violence, her capital ship patrols in search of conflict. Underestimate her, and face the wrath of her talons.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Quests/JadeShadowsP.descriptionZh: 维纳是赤毒女巫号致命的舰长，令人肃然起敬。也许只是因为无聊，也许是出于对杀伐的残酷迷恋，她驾驶主力战舰四处巡航，寻觅战火。但凡敢轻视她的人，都将直面其利爪之怒。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Quests/SandmanBoss/.name: /Lotus/Language/Game/HostileSandmanGiant
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Quests/SandmanBoss/.descriptionEn: Awoken by the Protector to help defend the Tomb of Inaros.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Quests/SandmanBoss/.descriptionZh: 被捍卫者唤醒来帮助守卫 Inaros 的古墓。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Quests/SandmanBoss/.name: /Lotus/Language/Game/HostileSandman
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Quests/SandmanBoss/.descriptionEn: Watches over the Tomb of Inaros.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/RelayEvent/GrineerR.name: /Lotus/Language/Game/GrineerChargerName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/RelayEvent/GrineerR.descriptionEn: Charges foes with devastating melee attacks
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/RelayEvent/GrineerR.descriptionZh: 以粉碎性的近战攻击重创敌人

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Aerolyst/.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientAerolystName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Aerolyst/.descriptionEn: A support unit can heal fellow Sentients. Canisters located near this units center of mass appear weaker than the surrounding carapace.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Aerolyst/.descriptionZh: 可以对 Sentient 同伴进行治疗的辅助单位。围绕在这个单位质心周围的罐状容器看起来要比周围的外壳更脆弱。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Aerolyst/.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientAerolystName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Aerolyst/.descriptionEn: A support unit can heal fellow Sentients. Canisters located near this units center of mass appear weaker than the surrounding carapace.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Aerolyst/.descriptionZh: 可以对 Sentient 同伴进行治疗的辅助单位。围绕在这个单位质心周围的罐状容器看起来要比周围的外壳更脆弱。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Brachioly.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientBrachiolystName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Brachioly.descriptionEn: Flying unit that can swoop down into melee.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Brachioly.descriptionZh: 可以俯冲下来近战攻击的飞行单位。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Brachioly.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientBrachiolystName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Brachioly.descriptionEn: Flying unit that can swoop down into melee.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Brachioly.descriptionZh: 可以俯冲下来近战攻击的飞行单位。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Brachioly.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/BrachCarrierName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Brachioly.descriptionEn: Sentient servitors ejected from an Orphix, these entities boost their master's pulse field by placing Serenex Resonators.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Brachioly.descriptionZh: 从奥影母艇弹出的 Sentient 侍从，这些实体通过放置共鸣者来增强它们主人的脉冲场。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Brachioly.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientBrachiolystName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Brachioly.descriptionEn: Flying unit that can swoop down into melee.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Brachioly.descriptionZh: 可以俯冲下来近战攻击的飞行单位。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Clotholys.name: /Lotus/Language/NewWar/Clotholyst
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Clotholys.descriptionEn: These rare, hulking Sentients pound adversaries to a pulp. Nearly immortal, they can only be killed by having their beating core torn from them.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Clotholys.descriptionZh: 这些罕见且笨重的 Sentient 会将对手打得粉碎。近乎不朽，只有将他们跳动的核心撕扯下来才能杀死他们。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Clotholys.name: /Lotus/Language/NewWar/Clotholyst
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Clotholys.descriptionEn: These rare, hulking Sentients pound adversaries to a pulp. Nearly immortal, they can only be killed by having their beating core torn from them.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Clotholys.descriptionZh: 这些罕见且笨重的 Sentient 会将对手打得粉碎。近乎不朽，只有将他们跳动的核心撕扯下来才能杀死他们。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Condrix/S.name: /Lotus/Language/SquadLink/CondrixAvatarName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Condrix/S.descriptionEn: This dropship ferries Sentients units from deep-space to battle zones around the Origin System.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Condrix/S.descriptionZh: 这艘运输舰将 Sentient 作战单位从外太空运送到始源星系附近的战区中。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Condrix/S.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/OrphixAvatarName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Condrix/S.descriptionEn: These massive Sentients emit pulses that disable machinery, and deploy lesser Sentients that help to boost the pulse field. They have recently learned to disable Warframes.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Condrix/S.descriptionZh: 这些巨大的 Sentient 发出使机械装置失效的脉冲，并部署较小的 Sentient 以帮助增强脉冲场。它们最近学会了使战甲失效的方法。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Dolicholy.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientDolicholystName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Dolicholy.descriptionEn: A high-order Sentient that bifurcates its body, creating a portal it uses to summon reinforcements and projectiles. Armed with twin cannons.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Dolicholy.descriptionZh: 高阶 Sentient，能把它的身体分叉，变成用来召唤援军和炮弹的传送门。装备有双管火炮。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Eidolon/S.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientEidolonGhostCasterName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Eidolon/S.descriptionEn: These ethereal Sentients attack with both a sonic barrage and a thunderous homing orb.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Eidolon/S.descriptionZh: 这些有灵性的 Sentient 通过音爆弹幕和轰隆作响的追踪球体进行攻击。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Eidolon/S.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/TeralystName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Eidolon/S.descriptionEn: An ancient Eidolon, searching for its lost brethren. Trying to make itself whole.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Eidolon/S.descriptionZh: 一个远古夜灵，寻找着它失去的同胞。试图回归完整。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Eidolon/S.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/TeralystBigName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Eidolon/S.descriptionEn: A massive, lumbering, brute of an Eidolon.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Eidolon/S.descriptionZh: 一种巨大、笨重且强力的的夜灵。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Eidolon/S.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/TeralystRainName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Eidolon/S.descriptionEn: The energy contained within this Eidolon is powerful enough to alter the local weather system.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Eidolon/S.descriptionZh: 这个夜灵所具有的强大能量足以改变周围的天气系统。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Eidolon/S.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/VomvalystName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Eidolon/S.descriptionEn: A lost soul. Part energy, part physical shell, these Sentient remnants seem to have a symbiotic relationship with the much larger Eidolons.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Eidolon/S.descriptionZh: 一个迷路的灵魂。一部分是能量，一部分是实体外壳，这些 Sentient 的残余似乎和某一个更庞大的夜灵有着共生关系。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/NewWar/Dr.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientBrachiolystName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/NewWar/Dr.descriptionEn: Flying unit that can swoop down into melee.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/NewWar/Dr.descriptionZh: 可以俯冲下来近战攻击的飞行单位。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/NewWar/Dr.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientMeleeGruntAltName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/NewWar/Dr.descriptionEn: A fledgling Conculyst deployed before it had a chance to fully develop.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/NewWar/Dr.descriptionZh: 一个幼年的震荡使，它在完全成长好之前就被编入军队了。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/NewWar/Dr.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientGruntAltName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/NewWar/Dr.descriptionEn: A fledgling Battalyst deployed before it had a chance to fully develop.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/NewWar/Dr.descriptionZh: 一个幼年的武装使，它在完全成长好之前就被编入军队了。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/NewWar/Dr.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientSymbilystName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/NewWar/Dr.descriptionEn: Frontline shock trooper that uses its large shield arm to block incoming damage.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/NewWar/Dr.descriptionZh: 前线突击部队，使用其强如盾牌的手臂阻挡受到的伤害。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/NewWar/Ne.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientBrachiolystName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/NewWar/Ne.descriptionEn: Flying unit that can swoop down into melee.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/NewWar/Ne.descriptionZh: 可以俯冲下来近战攻击的飞行单位。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/NewWar/Ne.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientOrtholystName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/NewWar/Ne.descriptionEn: This lightweight Sentient mounts itself to solid ground in order to deploy massive long range cannons.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/NewWar/Ne.descriptionZh: 这种轻型的 Sentient 可将自身固定在地面上，以部署大型远程火炮。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/NewWar/Ne.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/SentientSymbilystName

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/NewWar/Ne.descriptionZh: 前线突击部队，使用其强如盾牌的手臂阻挡受到的伤害。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/RailJack/.name: /Lotus/Language/Railjack/SentientBoardingBrachiolystName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/RailJack/.descriptionEn: This Brachiolyst attacks with ground-based melee strikes and projectiles.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/RailJack/.descriptionZh: 这种狂战使通过地面上的近战击打和投射物发起攻击。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Ropalolys.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/RopalolystName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Ropalolys.descriptionEn:
"Known and unknowable. This thing has haunted my life, waking and asleep, ever since I made that accursed bargain. A parasite at the core of my city. It drains my wealth, my power, my reactors… and my dignity.

This will not stand. I will see that horrendous thing destroyed.

I will be free."

Alad V
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Ropalolys.descriptionZh:
" 已知而不可知。自从我做了那项可憎的协议后，这件事情便日复一日、夜复一夜的困扰着我的人生。犹如我城市核心中的寄生虫，蚕食鲸吞掉我的财务、权利、反应炉，以及我的……身份。

这不会得逞的，我会亲眼见证那可怕的东西被摧毁。

我终将获得自由之身。"

阿拉德 V

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/SpaceBattles/Corpus.name: /Lotus/Language/Railjack/CorpusFighterChargeEliteName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/SpaceBattles/Corpus.descriptionEn: The elite incarnation of this Corpus fighter. It attacks with a swivel turret that locks on and then focuses its triple-beam array, delivering continuous damage. Deployed to Venus Proxima.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/SpaceBattles/Corpus.descriptionZh: 正面由护盾防护，并配备了一门高蓄能等离子炮。被部署在了金星比邻星域。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/SpaceBattles/Corpus.name: /Lotus/Language/Railjack/CorpusFighterLaserEliteName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/SpaceBattles/Corpus.descriptionEn: The elite incarnation of this Corpus attack fighter gains the ability to teleport-dash short distances, leaving a blinding flare in its wake. Deployed to Venus Proxima.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/SpaceBattles/Sentie.descriptionEn: A heavy Sentient fighter that weakens targets with a slicing plasma wave and finishes them off with a massive energy orb.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/SpaceBattles/Sentie.descriptionEn: This unorthodox Sentient Fighter tumbles and twists through space, attacking with its dual missile launchers and a barrage of swarming micro missiles.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/SpaceBattles/Sentie.descriptionZh: 这种另类的 Sentient 战斗机在太空中翻滚扭动，借助它的两个导弹发射器和密集的微型导弹进行轰炸攻击。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/Bosses/CoHI.name: /Lotus/Language/1999/LegacyteName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/Bosses/CoHI.descriptionEn: With each generation, this Techrot predator becomes stronger, evolving new powers and attacks. Evolving these powerful creatures is metabolically costly for the Techrot, could this be exploited to weaken the Infestation?
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/Bosses/CoHI.descriptionZh: 随着每一代的进化，这种科腐者捕食者变得越来越强大，进化出新的能力和攻击方式。进化这些强大的生物对科腐者来说需要消耗大量的能量，这一点是否可以利用来削弱 Infestation？

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/Bosses/CoHM.name: /Lotus/Language/EntratiLab/EntratiGeneral/OctopedeVariantA
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/Bosses/CoHM.descriptionEn: On the rare occasions when Murmur fragments assemble themselves into a whole, the result is a monstrous and potent entity. It may manifest in three different forms, the Suzerain, Zelator and Anchorite, with a fourth form, the 'Fragmented One', being the most formidable of all. Together, as heralds of the Indifference, they tether down the Strands of Khra down which their bizarre master must travel.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/Bosses/CoHM.descriptionZh: 在极少数情况下，低语者断肢会组合成一个整体。这种情况下会产生一个强大的怪物。它可能有三种不同的形态：宗主级、信徒级和隐士级，而第四种形态的"接肢至尊"则是其中最可怕的。作为虚空无情之物的使者，它们固定着时间丝线，而它们奇异的主人则必须沿着时间丝线才能前进。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/Bosses/CoHO.name: /Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverOraxiaBossName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/Bosses/CoHO.descriptionEn: A servitor to Albrecht Entrati, she was bound to the protection of Scholar's Landing. However, long years of isolation made her vulnerable to the manipulative whispers of Neci Rusalka. Now, she serves a new master, and attacks anyone who dares set foot on the isle.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/Bosses/CoHO.descriptionZh: 作为阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的侍从，她必须保护儒临地。然而，长年的与世隔绝使她很容易被内奇·鲁莎卡的低语操控。如今，她为一位新主人效忠，胆敢踏足这座岛屿的人都会遭到她的攻击。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/Bosses/CoHP.name: /Lotus/Language/Suits/PaxDuviricusFrameName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/Bosses/CoHP.descriptionEn: Kullervo answers for his sins and the sins of others. His daggers and melee prowess deal high damage. Seize the power of treachery to slake his thirst for revenge.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/Bosses/CoHP.descriptionZh: Kullervo 背负着自己和他人的罪孽。他的匕首和近战能力可以造成高额伤害。抓住背叛的力量来满足他对复仇的渴望。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/CoHEliteShi.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/CorpusEliteShieldDroneName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/CoHEliteShi.descriptionEn: The Arbiters of Hexis created this drone to put Tenno to the test in Arbitrations.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/CoHEliteShi.descriptionZh: 由均衡仲裁者所制作的无人机，使 Tenno 在裁决中受到考验。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/CoHRepairDr.name: /Lotus/Language/Entrati/EntratiLabsRepairDroneName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/CoHRepairDr.descriptionEn: These helpful Necramites have helped keep Albrecht Entrati's Laboratories in tip top shape while Loid and the Cavia were in stasis.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/CoHRepairDr.descriptionZh: 当洛德和科维兽处于冷冻舱时，这些乐于助人的殁世微灵使阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的实验室保持在最佳状态。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/CoHTreasure.name: /Lotus/Language/DanteUnbound/DisruptionLootGoblin
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/CoHTreasure.descriptionEn: These greedy little Murmur tricksters love to steal Conduit Dockets and other coveted items from Albrecht's labs.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/CoHTreasure.descriptionZh: 这些贪婪的低语者小调皮鬼喜欢从阿尔布雷希特的实验室偷取导管文卷和其他珍贵的物品。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/PowerCellCa.name: /Lotus/Language/1999PvPvE/PvPvE99AeriaExcavationCarrier
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/PowerCellCa.descriptionEn: This automated aerial unit tracks and triangulates its target with lasers and then fires a high caliber rifle shot.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/PowerCellCa.descriptionZh: 这种自动化空中单位通过激光对目标进行三角定位，然后发射大口径步枪子弹。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/PowerCellCa.name: /Lotus/Language/1999PvPvE/PvPvE99ExcavationCarrier
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/PowerCellCa.descriptionEn: This rifle unit has been trained to suppress the enemy with volley after volley of machine gun fire.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/PowerCellCa.descriptionZh: 这个步枪单位被训练来以机枪齐射压制敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/PowerCellCa.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/CorruptedPowerCarrier
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/PowerCellCa.descriptionEn: [PH] A Corrupted Lancer carrying a power cell
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/CoH/PowerCellCa.descriptionZh: [PH] A Corrupted Lancer carrying a power cell

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Dax/TauDaxArche.descriptionZh: 自由派禁卫派系的一员。禁卫游侠在 Tenno 初学操控战甲时提供支援并不罕见，他们常用精准的射击填补进攻空档。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Dax/TauDaxHeavy.name: /Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFinal/TauDaxHeavyArchgunName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Dax/TauDaxHeavy.descriptionEn: A member of the separatist Dax Anarch faction. Across many operations, the thunderous salvo of a Libritor Archgun served as a signal for hidden Dax forces to emerge from the shadows and fall upon their enemies like a guillotine's blade.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Dax/TauDaxHeavy.descriptionZh: 自由派禁卫派系的一员。在许多行动中，解放者曲翼枪械雷鸣般的齐射声都作为信号，引导隐藏的禁卫部队从阴影中现身，如同断头台的利刃般扑向敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Dax/TauDaxLustr.name: /Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFinal/TauDaxLustratusName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Dax/TauDaxLustr.descriptionEn: A commanding officer of the separatist Dax Anarch faction. Exceptional even amongst the extraordinary, the shining armor of a Lustratus marked Dax who were fit for leadership over their brethren in battle.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Dax/TauDaxLustr.descriptionZh: 自由派禁卫派系的一名指挥官。即便在强者之中，他也堪称佼佼者。光肃官禁卫所穿的闪亮盔甲，象征着他们有能力在战场上领导自己的同袍。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Dax/TauDaxMedic.name: /Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFinal/TauDaxMedicName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Dax/TauDaxMedic.descriptionEn: A member of the separatist Dax Anarch faction. With shield above and staff in hand, Dax medics are as adept at healing as their brethren are at cutting down the opposition.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Dax/TauDaxMedic.descriptionZh: 自由派禁卫派系的一员。禁卫医疗兵高举盾牌，手持长杖，他们不仅擅长治疗，而且和他们的同胞一样精于杀敌。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Grineer/Dropshi.name: /Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFinal/TauGrineerDropshipName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Grineer/Dropshi.descriptionEn: The pride of the Tusk fleet, the Bolkor is the ideal platform from which to mount ground operations. Equipped with a high capacity rotary cannon, densely plated and with enough space to carry a platoon, the Bolkor holds its own raining down fire and dropping squad after squad at regular intervals.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Grineer/Dropshi.descriptionZh: 博寇是巨牙舰队的骄傲，是进行地面作战的理想平台。装备有大容量的旋转火炮，并密布装甲，且拥有足够的空间容纳一整个排，博寇具有强大的自持能力，足以定期地降下火雨，并投送一队又一队的人员。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Grineer/TauGrin.name: /Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFinal/AnarchGrineerLancerName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Grineer/TauGrin.descriptionEn: A cloned soldier in top fighting form. Lancers formed the front line of the Orokin legions, advancing relentlessly to carry the full might of the army deep into enemy territory. Lancers were chosen for sheer-minded determination, the ones who found it hard to let go of an idea.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Grineer/TauGrin.descriptionZh: 一名克隆士兵，战斗力处于巅峰状态。枪兵是奥罗金军团的前线，他们不知疲倦地推进，将军队的全部力量深入敌后。枪兵的选拔标准是意志坚定，他们一旦认定某个想法，就很难放弃。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Grineer/TauGrin.nameZh: 自由派 Grineer 捕猎者
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Grineer/TauGrin.descriptionEn: Only the most cunning of clone stock are chosen to become trappers. These are given training in the operation of Trapper Drones by Archimedea; many do not make it through the training. Trappers are frequently ostracized from their squads due to mishaps while they are learning to aim.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Grineer/TauGrin.descriptionZh: 只有最狡猾的克隆人才能被选中成为捕猎者。他们会接受科研的训练，学习如何操作捕猎无人机；许多人无法通过训练。由于在学习瞄准过程中容易发生意外，捕猎者经常被小队排斥。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Grineer/TauGrin.descriptionEn: A drone deployed by Grineer Trappers to ensnare their victims. Beams of electricity pick out targets, before stunning swaths of foes with a wide burst of electricity. The drone's systems are idiosyncratic, sharing no commonalities with any other Orokin device.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Grineer/TauGrin.descriptionZh: 这是 Grineer 捕猎者部署的一种无人机，用于诱捕受害者。它会发射电光束锁定目标，然后用大范围的电流冲击波击晕大片敌人。这种无人机的系统独一无二，与任何其他奥罗金设备都截然不同。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/GuiltSentient/D.descriptionEn: Sentient dactolyst, taken and twisted by the Anarch Galastra. Given the designation TQ-776VL by his captor, if he had taken an independent name before this, it has been lost.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/GuiltSentient/D.descriptionZh: Sentient 指节使，被自由派加拉斯特俘虏并扭曲。俘虏他的人为其取名为 TQ-776VL，如果他之前曾有自己的名字，那么现在已经遗失了。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Monolyst/HardMo.descriptionEn: These ethereal Sentients attack with both a sonic barrage and a thunderous homing orb.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Monolyst/HardMo.descriptionZh: 这些有灵性的 Sentient 通过音爆弹幕和轰隆作响的追踪球体进行攻击。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Primes/Caliban/.name: /Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientSummonGhostCasterAvatarName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Primes/Caliban/.descriptionEn: These ethereal Sentients attack with both a sonic barrage and a thunderous homing orb.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Primes/Caliban/.descriptionZh: 这些有灵性的 Sentient 通过音爆弹幕和轰隆作响的追踪球体进行攻击。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Primes/Caliban/.name: /Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientSummonRangeAvatarName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Primes/Caliban/.descriptionEn: This lightweight Sentient mounts itself to solid ground in order to deploy massive long range cannons.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Primes/Caliban/.descriptionZh: 这种轻型的 Sentient 可将自身固定在地面上，以部署大型远程火炮。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Primes/Caliban/.name: /Lotus/Language/Suits/SentientSummonTankAvatarName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Primes/Caliban/.descriptionEn: A high-order Sentient that bifurcates its body, creating a portal it uses to summon reinforcements and projectiles. Armed with twin cannons.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Primes/Caliban/.descriptionZh: 高阶 Sentient，能把它的身体分叉，变成用来召唤援军和炮弹的传送门。装备有双管火炮。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Sentient/Carrio.name: /Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFinal/TauSentientCarrioniteName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Sentient/Carrio.descriptionEn: A Sentient drone deployed from a Hunhullus. Carrionites scan the terrain for enemy units, alerting their lumbering master who will then obliterate them.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Sentient/Carrio.descriptionZh: 一架由英魂统使部署的 Sentient 无人机。腐生无人机会扫描地形，寻找敌军，并将警报传递给它们笨重的主人，主人随后会将敌军彻底摧毁。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Sentient/Marrow.name: /Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFinal/TauSentientMarrowtickName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Sentient/Marrow.descriptionEn: Swarming micro-drones deployed from a Sentient Hunhullus. When destroyed Marrowticks have the curious property of creating gravitic fields imbued with Void radiation, a possible consequence of their earlier role in assisting with the construction of the Solar Rail between the Origin System and Tau.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Sentient/Marrow.descriptionZh: 成群的微型无人机从 Sentient 英魂统使部署而来。当被摧毁时，骨髓蜱具有一种奇特的特性，即会产生充满虚空辐射的引力场，这可能是它们早期参与建造始源星系和 Tau 星系之间的星际航道所导致的后果。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Uriel/UrielBoss.name: /Lotus/Language/TauPrequel/TauPrequelFinal/RoatheBossName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Uriel/UrielBoss.descriptionEn: The feared Orokin commander Vice Regent Grand Carnus Roathe, whose battlefield prowess was legendary even among the Seven.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Uriel/UrielBoss.descriptionZh: 令人闻风丧胆的奥罗金指挥官副摄政总司令罗瑟，其战场上的英勇事迹即使在七人众之中也堪称传奇。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Fai.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/FairyQuestLoki
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Fai.descriptionZh: 一位擅长狡猾和欺骗的斗士。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Fai.name: /Lotus/Language/Enemies/FairyQuestSarynMolt
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Fai.descriptionEn: Fast and explodes when near enemies
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Fai.descriptionZh: 快速接近并在敌人附近自爆

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Oda.name: /Lotus/Language/DeadlockProtocol/ProteaQuestBossName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Oda.descriptionEn: The victim and beneficiary of Parvos Granum's research into Specter Particle Theory, this is all that remains of the Protea Warframe who sacrificed herself to keep Granum safe in a pocket realm beyond time.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Oda.descriptionZh: Protea 既是帕尔沃斯·格拉努的"魅影粒子理论"研究的受益者，也是受害者。在完成了自我牺牲，并将格拉努安全地封存在一个超越时间的口袋空间后，这是这个战甲所残存下来的全部痕迹，仅此而已。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.name: /Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverOraxiaBossName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.descriptionEn: A servitor to Albrecht Entrati, she was bound to the protection of Scholar's Landing. However, long years of isolation made her vulnerable to the manipulative whispers of Neci Rusalka. Now, she serves a new master, and attacks anyone who dares set foot on the isle.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.descriptionZh: 作为阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的侍从，她必须保护儒临地。然而，长年的与世隔绝使她很容易被内奇·鲁莎卡的低语操控。如今，她为一位新主人效忠，胆敢踏足这座岛屿的人都会遭到她的攻击。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.name: /Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverOraxiaBossName

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.name: /Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverSpiderlingsName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.descriptionEn: Spiderlings born from the guardian of Scholar's Landing. Though precious to their mother, an explosively short life leaves only the hunt to bond over.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.descriptionZh: 儒临地守护者所生的蜘蛛幼崽。虽然它们对母亲来说弥足珍贵，但生命却异常短暂，只能通过狩猎来维系彼此的羁绊。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.name: /Lotus/Language/Isleweaver/IsleweaverSpiderlingSuicideName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.descriptionEn: These aggressive and explosive Scuttlers have one purpose to fulfil in their short lives; protect their mother.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.descriptionZh: 这些具有攻击性且易爆的急行蛛在它们短暂的一生中只有一个目标：保护它们的母亲。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.name: /Lotus/Language/1999/ProtoInfestedAncientName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.descriptionEn: Even redundant technology is given new life through the Technocyte Virus.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.descriptionZh: 甚至过时的技术也通过科技细胞病毒获得了新生。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.name: /Lotus/Language/1999/ProtoInfestedAncientName

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.name: /Lotus/Language/1999/ProtoInfestedBabauName

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.descriptionZh: 人类智慧的快速荒废催生了恶魔。恶魔通常于被忽视的地狱净化器上被发现。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.name: /Lotus/Language/1999/TechrotJugulusName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.descriptionEn: A fearsome adversary that erupts out of the Techrot mass below.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.descriptionZh: 一个可怕的敌人从地下的科腐者聚落中破土而出。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.name: /Lotus/Language/1999/TechrotJugulusName

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.descriptionZh: 一个可怕的敌人从地下的科腐者聚落中破土而出。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.name: /Lotus/Language/1999/ProtoInfestedMaggot
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.descriptionEn: These tiny nodules of Techrot are the diabolic union of an arc welder and a gas can. Usually attacking in groups, they explode as soon as they near their target.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.descriptionZh: 这些科腐者小瘤子是电弧焊机和汽油罐的结合体，非常可怕。它们通常成群攻击，一旦靠近目标就会爆炸。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.name: /Lotus/Language/1999/ProtoInfestedMoaName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.descriptionEn: Once a simple workstation, the servant has turned against its former masters.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.descriptionZh: 这个曾经是个简单的工作站的东西如今已经背叛了它过去的主人。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.name: /Lotus/Language/1999/ProtoInfestedMoaName

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.name: /Lotus/Language/1999/ProtoInfestedRunnerName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.descriptionEn: This agressive melee unit dashes at enemies, lashing out with frenzied strikes.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.descriptionZh: 这个攻击性极强的近战单位会冲向敌人，并发动疯狂的攻击。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.name: /Lotus/Language/1999/ProtoInfestedZongroName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.descriptionEn: This tottering, bulbous Techrot creation can inflate bladders to become airborne, raining down destruction on those below.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.descriptionZh: 这种摇摇欲坠的团状科腐者造物可以通过充气来升空，向下方降下毁灭之雨。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.name: /Lotus/Language/1999/ProtoInfestedVolatileRunnerName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.descriptionEn: This self-sacrificing unit ignites its subsumed propane tank and then charges its prey, for the survival of the Hive.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.descriptionZh: 为了种群的存续，这个个体选择了自我牺牲。它会引燃其体内的丙烷罐，然后向猎物发起攻击。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.name: /Lotus/Language/1999/LegacyteName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.descriptionEn: With each generation, this Techrot predator becomes stronger, evolving new powers and attacks. Evolving these powerful creatures is metabolically costly for the Techrot, could this be exploited to weaken the Infestation?
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.descriptionZh: 随着每一代的进化，这种科腐者捕食者变得越来越强大，进化出新的能力和攻击方式。进化这些强大的生物对科腐者来说需要消耗大量的能量，这一点是否可以利用来削弱 Infestation？

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Infested/Infe.name: /Lotus/Language/1999/LegacyteName

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Disru.name: /Lotus/Language/1999/LasrianChemStrikeNoxDisruptionName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Disru.descriptionEn: Specialized Scaldra demoltions unit, with an impressive vocal range.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Disru.descriptionZh: 炽蛇军的特种爆破单位，兼具震撼的音域。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.name: /Lotus/Language/1999Demo/LasrianButcherName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.descriptionEn: Quick and lethal. This Scaldra unit has been trained to rush the target and inflict maximum damage with their curved blades.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.descriptionZh: 快速而致命。这个炽蛇军单位训练有素，能够携带其弯曲的刀刃冲向目标以造成最大伤害。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.name: /Lotus/Language/1999Demo/LasrianButcherName

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.descriptionEn: This heavily armored, slow moving unit lays down the law with dual Efervon cannons.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.descriptionZh: 这个装甲厚重、行动缓慢的单位使用双管艾弗旺机关炮来控制战局。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.name: /Lotus/Language/1999Demo/LasrianDroneName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.descriptionEn: This automated aerial unit tracks and triangulates its target with lasers and then fires a high caliber rifle shot.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.descriptionZh: 这种自动化空中单位通过激光对目标进行三角定位，然后发射大口径步枪子弹。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.name: /Lotus/Language/1999/LasrianDropshipName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.nameZh: 炽蛇军 TI-92 运兵车
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.descriptionEn: This armored personnel carrier is designed to move Scaldra forces quickly and easily around Höllvania. Its roof mounted turret provides lethal defense.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.descriptionZh: 这款装甲运兵车旨在让炽蛇军部队在霍瓦尼亚快速部署。其车顶炮台会用致命的火力进行防御。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.name: /Lotus/Language/1999Demo/LasrianGoonadierName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/WF1999Lasrian/Lasri.descriptionEn: This support unit smokes out its target with gas grenades and finishes the job with blows from his massive club.

/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/BerserkerMel.descriptionEn: These talons emerge when Valkyr unleashes her Hysteria.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Berserker/BerserkerMel.descriptionZh: 这些利爪将于 Valkyr 解放她的狂化爆发力量时显现。

/Lotus/Powersuits/Sentient/SummonOrtholy.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/RifleName
/Lotus/Powersuits/Sentient/SummonOrtholy.descriptionEn: The Braton's high rate of fire and accuracy make it a favorite among the Tenno.
/Lotus/Powersuits/Sentient/SummonOrtholy.descriptionZh: （英文：BRATON）布莱顿是一支自动步枪。高射速和高精度使其成为了 Tenno 的最爱。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Acolytes/AcolyteOpt.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CrpBfgName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Acolytes/AcolyteOpt.descriptionEn: Once charged this Corpus laser cannon dispatches a devastating blast of light energy.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Acolytes/AcolyteOpt.descriptionZh: （英文：OPTICOR ）一旦这挺 Corpus 激光炮充能完毕，便能释放出毁灭性的光能爆炸。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Acolytes/AcolyteRap.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/TnoRapierName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Acolytes/AcolyteRap.descriptionEn: Elevate martial combat into an art form with this Tenno rapier.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Acolytes/AcolyteRap.descriptionZh: （英文：DESTREZA）用这把 Tenno 细剑以艺术的方式来提升武术战斗技巧。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Acolytes/ControlAco.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/DualVastosName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Acolytes/ControlAco.descriptionEn: Vasto revolvers equipped in each hand.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Acolytes/ControlAco.descriptionZh: （英文：AKVASTO）双手各持一把瓦斯托左轮手枪。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Acolytes/RogueAcoly.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/TennoMiosName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Acolytes/RogueAcoly.descriptionEn: In the practiced hands of a master, this blade and whip becomes exceedingly devastating.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Acolytes/RogueAcoly.descriptionZh: （英文：LACERA）在熟练的大师手中，这把剑鞭极具毁灭性。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Acolytes/StrikerAco.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/TennoClawsName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Acolytes/StrikerAco.descriptionEn: Utilizing a new fighting stance, this Tenno weapon turns fists into claws and enemies into messy piles of meat and scrap metal.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Acolytes/StrikerAco.descriptionZh: （英文：VENKA）运用一种全新的战斗姿势，这把 Tenno 武器可以把拳头变为利爪，把敌人变成散乱的肉块及废铁。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Wea.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/SniperRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Wea.descriptionEn: Manufactured by the Corpus, the Snipetron is a powerful and accurate rifle that sports optical zoom capabilities. Perfect for long range engagements.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Wea.descriptionZh: （英文：SNIPETRON）由 Corpus 加工，狙击特昂是一把具备变焦能力的强力精准步枪。适合远距离战斗。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Amalgams/Wea.descriptionZh: （英文：IGNIS）伊格尼斯能产生一股强烈的热浪。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/BipedRobot/A.descriptionEn: Sobek is a rapid-firing Grineer shotgun that has reduced damage per shot but boasts extra large magazine capacity.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/BipedRobot/A.descriptionZh: （英文：SOBEK）鳄神是一把速射型 Grineer 霰弹枪，虽降低每一枪的伤害，但拥有超大弹匣容量。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/CorpusShipRe.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/DualCorpusMinigunName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/CorpusShipRe.descriptionEn: Wield two Cestras to unleash a dual torrent of high energy bolts.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/CorpusShipRe.descriptionZh: （英文：DUAL CESTRA）双手各持一把锡斯特释放出双流高能量弹幕。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/CorpusShipRe.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpShapeBlastName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/CorpusShipRe.descriptionEn: Feel the kick of this Corpus shotgun as it shatters a high-yield crystal into anyone and anything standing in your way.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/CorpusShipRe.descriptionZh: （英文：EXERGIS）当这把 Corpus 霰弹枪将高产水晶轰入阻挡在你前方的任何人或物时，请细细品味其后坐力。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/CorpusShipRe.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBlastorWeaponName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/CorpusShipRe.descriptionEn: Cultivate a meaningful relationship with this deceptively simple battery-powered pistol. The Plinx rewards attention and investment from the wise.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/CorpusShipRe.descriptionZh: （英文：PLINX）与这把看似朴素的电池手枪培养出深厚的情感。漫射者最能回馈来自智者的关注与投资。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/CorpusShipRe.descriptionZh: （英文：GLAXION）发射出一道能暂停分子振动的光子束，造成痛苦的瞬间冻结。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/CorpusShipRe.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/BeamWeaponName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/CorpusShipRe.descriptionEn: Therma is a short range weapon that deals a constant stream of damage.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/CorpusShipRe.descriptionZh: THERMA 是一把持续输出伤害的短程武器。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/GasCity/Weap.descriptionEn: Stagger targets with blasts from this Corpus engineered plasma shotgun. Surviving enemies are consumed with radiation.
