/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/QuadRobot/Mi.descriptionZh: THERMA 是一把持续输出伤害的短程武器。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBEArcaPlasmorName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionEn: Custom variant of a Corpus classic. Staggering blasts now ricochet and have greater range at the cost of a slower fire and reload speed. Surviving enemies are consumed with radiation.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionZh: （英文：TENET ARCA PLASMOR）Corpus 经典武器的特制变体。惊人的爆炸会反弹且拥有更高的射程，但代价是更低的射速和装填速度。幸存下来的敌人会被辐射耗尽生命。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/RifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionEn: The Braton's high rate of fire and accuracy make it a favorite among the Tenno.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionZh: （英文：BRATON）布莱顿是一支自动步枪。高射速和高精度使其成为了 Tenno 的最爱。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/ArchLongRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionEn: Devastate free-space enemies with Phaedra, the Soma's big-sister.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionZh: （英文：PHAEDRA）借由这把菲德菈——月神最年长的姊妹——纵横太空尽情毁灭敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.name: /Lotus/Language/ClanTech/GrenadeLauncherName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionEn: The Penta Launcher fires up to five grenades that can be remotely triggered at just the right moment.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionZh: （英文：PENTA）潘塔发射器最多可发射五发榴弹，并在最适当的时候进行远距离引爆。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/ConclaveBfgName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.nameZh: 奥堤克光子枪 变体
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionEn: Once charged this Corpus laser cannon dispatches a devastating blast of light energy.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionZh: （英文：OPTICOR ）一旦这挺 Corpus 激光炮充能完毕，便能释放出毁灭性的光能爆炸。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpRubanRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionEn: Nail them to the wall! The Stahlta automatic rifle propels hardened steel rods at high speed, while a charged fire mode fuses a number of volatile rods together for a large radioactive explosion.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionZh: （英文：STAHLTA）将敌人钉在墙上！这件钢刃自动步枪把硬化钢棒推进到高速状态，而蓄力射击模式会将大量不稳定的钢棒融合在一起，产生巨大的放射性爆炸。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CrpElectroMag
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionEn: Send a massive charge of potential energy hurling toward unfortunate targets.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionZh: （英文：STATICOR）将强大的静电势能射向不幸的敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerStaffName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionEn: Fashioned with Grineer materials and balanced for marine infantry use, the Amphis is a traditional staff weapon that has received a monstrous makeover that enables shock damage on jump attacks. Connects with multiple enemies with each strike.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionZh: （英文：AMPHIS）以 Grineer 材料制成，设计为海军陆战队使用，双头蛇是一把为了附带电击伤害而接受了大幅改造的传统棍棒武器——跳跃攻击附带电击伤害。可以同时打击多个敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaNukorName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionEn: A highly-optimized Nukor that allows for the weapon’s microwave field to hit up to two additional targets.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionZh: （英文：KUVA NUKOR）一把高度优化的努寇微波枪，可以通过其微波场击中最多两个额外目标。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpHammerShieldName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionEn: Drive the agenda with this massive impact hammer. Heavy attacks launch devastating energy disks.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionZh: （英文：TENET AGENDUS）用这把重型冲击锤推动议程。重击会发射毁灭性的能量盘。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CrpShockRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionEn: This weapon was designed to assist with the excavation of mineral deposits from large asteroids, but has been adapted for military purposes.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionZh: （英文：QUANTA）这个武器原本是设计用来在大型小行星上协助挖掘矿物，但现在已更改为应用于军事用途上。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusUMPName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionEn: Drawing from its huge quad-chambered magazine, the Tetra is capable of unleashing a sustained barrage of lethal energy bolts.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionZh: （英文：TETRA）借由它巨大的四腔弹匣，特拉能持续发射由能量弹形成的致命弹幕。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/ChainLightningRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionEn: The Amprex rifle fires a continuous beam of high voltage electricity that arcs among nearby enemies. This weapon excels at Crowd Control.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Ava.descriptionZh: （英文：AMPREX）安培克斯步枪可持续发射致命电光束并在敌人中形成电弧。这件武器在群体控制方面很优秀。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Wea.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpShapeBlastName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Wea.descriptionEn: Feel the kick of this Corpus shotgun as it shatters a high-yield crystal into anyone and anything standing in your way.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Wea.descriptionZh: （英文：EXERGIS）当这把 Corpus 霰弹枪将高产水晶轰入阻挡在你前方的任何人或物时，请细细品味其后坐力。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Wea.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerDoubleBarrellName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Wea.descriptionEn: Sobek is a rapid-firing Grineer shotgun that has reduced damage per shot but boasts extra large magazine capacity.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Railjack/Wea.descriptionZh: （英文：SOBEK）鳄神是一把速射型 Grineer 霰弹枪，虽降低每一枪的伤害，但拥有超大弹匣容量。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Spaceman/Wea.name: /Lotus/Language/ClanTech/CrpHeavyRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Spaceman/Wea.descriptionEn: The SUPRA is a heavy laser gun with a short wind up time.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Spaceman/Wea.descriptionZh: （英文：SUPRA）苏普拉是把重型激光枪，可在很短的时间内启动。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Spaceman/Wea.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/ModCrpSwarmCannonName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Spaceman/Wea.descriptionEn: Fires a cluster of swarming projectiles

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Turrets/Turr.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CrpBfgName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Turrets/Turr.descriptionEn: Once charged this Corpus laser cannon dispatches a devastating blast of light energy.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Turrets/Turr.descriptionZh: （英文：OPTICOR ）一旦这挺 Corpus 激光炮充能完毕，便能释放出毁灭性的光能爆炸。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Avatar.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/EnergyRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Avatar.descriptionEn: The Dera is a repeater that fires super-heated plasma.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Avatar.descriptionZh: （英文：DERA）德拉是一把射出高热电浆的连发步枪。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Weapon.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusUMPName

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Weapon.descriptionEn: Stagger targets with blasts from this Corpus engineered plasma shotgun. Surviving enemies are consumed with radiation.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Weapon.descriptionZh: （英文：ARCA PLASMOR）用这把 Corpus 设计的等离子霰弹枪来击倒你的目标。幸存下来的敌人会被辐射耗尽生命。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Weapon.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CrpBfgName

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Weapon.descriptionZh: （英文：SOBEK）鳄神是一把速射型 Grineer 霰弹枪，虽降低每一枪的伤害，但拥有超大弹匣容量。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Weapon.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/SniperRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Weapon.descriptionEn: Manufactured by the Corpus, the Snipetron is a powerful and accurate rifle that sports optical zoom capabilities. Perfect for long range engagements.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Weapon.descriptionZh: （英文：SNIPETRON）由 Corpus 加工，狙击特昂是一把具备变焦能力的强力精准步枪。适合远距离战斗。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Weapon.name: /Lotus/Language/ClanTech/CrpHeavyRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Venus/Weapon.descriptionEn: The SUPRA is a heavy laser gun with a short wind up time.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/BeamWeaponName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.descriptionEn: Therma is a short range weapon that deals a constant stream of damage.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.descriptionZh: THERMA 是一把持续输出伤害的短程武器。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/BeamWeaponName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.descriptionEn: Therma is a short range weapon that deals a constant stream of damage.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Arachnoi.descriptionZh: THERMA 是一把持续输出伤害的短程武器。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Infested.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/InfQuantaRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Infested.descriptionEn: Completely overwhelmed by Infested biology, this former Quanta now fires organic ordnance and a harpoon like appendage.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Corpus/Vip/Infested.descriptionZh: （英文：PARACYST）被感染生物体完全包覆，这种形态的量子切割器会射出类似器质性的附肢尖叉。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/DethCubePowerSuitStoreItemName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.descriptionEn: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube acts exactly as advertised, as a badass cube of 'deth'. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.descriptionZh: 以「突击模式」和「汽化」为预设指令，死亡魔方就像广告宣传的那样，是一个带来死亡的超棒魔方，内置死亡机枪。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/ChainLightningRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.descriptionEn: The Amprex rifle fires a continuous beam of high voltage electricity that arcs among nearby enemies. This weapon excels at Crowd Control.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.descriptionZh: （英文：AMPREX）安培克斯步枪可持续发射致命电光束并在敌人中形成电弧。这件武器在群体控制方面很优秀。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/DualCorpusMinigunName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.descriptionEn: Wield two Cestras to unleash a dual torrent of high energy bolts.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.descriptionZh: （英文：DUAL CESTRA）双手各持一把锡斯特释放出双流高能量弹幕。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/ShotgunName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.descriptionEn: The Strun is a standard shotgun. Reliable, versatile and deadly.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.descriptionZh: （英文：STRUN）斯特朗是一把标准的霰弹枪，可靠，灵活，致命。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CrpFreezeRayRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.descriptionEn: Fires a photon beam that halts molecular vibrations, causing instant and painful freezing.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.descriptionZh: （英文：GLAXION）发射出一道能暂停分子振动的光子束，造成痛苦的瞬间冻结。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusPunchKickWeaponName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.descriptionEn: The Obex system multiplies the kinetic energy of a Tenno's kicks and punches, delivering devastating blows to any target.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.descriptionZh: （英文：OBEX）奥比克斯战斗系统能强化 Tenno 的近身肉搏能力，给予目标致命伤害。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CrpBfgName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.descriptionEn: Once charged this Corpus laser cannon dispatches a devastating blast of light energy.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.descriptionZh: （英文：PENTA）潘塔发射器最多可发射五发榴弹，并在最适当的时候进行远距离引爆。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/CorpusSpearGunName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.descriptionEn: Discharge a rail of ionized death or throw the Ferrox like a spear and create a localized field of attraction no enemy can escape from.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.descriptionZh: （英文：FERROX）释放一道电离的死光，或掷出铁晶磁轨炮以产生一个敌人无法逃脱的局部吸引力场。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/HeliosGlaiveWeaponName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.descriptionEn: Causes the Helios Sentinel to attack enemy targets using pieces of itself.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.descriptionZh: （英文：DECONSTRUCTOR）赫利俄斯用自己身上的部件攻击目标敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CrpAirPistolArrayName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.descriptionEn: Blasts targets with a massive wave of sonic energy. Results reported to be: 'Very Satisfying'.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.descriptionZh: （英文：SONICOR）以巨大的声波能量震飞目标。使用报告的结果是：非常爽。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/CorpusTonfaName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.descriptionEn: Bring the enemy to its knees with these twin electrified tonfas.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.descriptionZh: （英文：OHMA）用这对带电的双子拐刃使你的敌人跪地求饶。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CrpFreezeRayRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Cha.descriptionEn: Fires a photon beam that halts molecular vibrations, causing instant and painful freezing.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Spe.descriptionEn: The Boltor fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Spe.descriptionZh: （英文：BOLTOR）螺钉步枪所发射出的的慢速重型螺钉足以将敌人钉在墙上。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Spe.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/LongSwordName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Spe.descriptionEn: Before all other weapons, Tenno master the Skana. This simple blade becomes immensely powerful in the hands of a master. For Tenno, it is the foundation of their fighting style and a pillar of their culture.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Spe.descriptionZh: （英文：SKANA）Tenno 在各种武器之中，最先精通的是空刃。其朴素的刀刃在他们手中是无比的强大。对Tenno 来说，这是他们战斗的基础以及文化的支柱。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Spe.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/ShotgunName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Spe.descriptionEn: The Strun is a standard shotgun. Reliable, versatile and deadly.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Spe.descriptionZh: （英文：STRUN）斯特朗是一把标准的霰弹枪，可靠，灵活，致命。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Spe.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/BurstRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Spe.descriptionEn: The Burston fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of automatic rifles and the accuracy of semi-automatic rifles.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Spe.descriptionZh: （英文：BURSTON）伯斯顿是三发点射步枪，在机枪的杀伤力和半自动的准确度之间取得平衡。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.name: /Lotus/Language/ClanTech/CrpLaserRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.descriptionEn: Laser Rifle with Corpus safe-guards removed.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/CorpusChampions/Tea.descriptionZh: （英文：FLUX RIFLE）一把已卸除了 Corpus 安全装置的激光步枪。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Duviri/Dax/Weapons/.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrnTridentName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Duviri/Dax/Weapons/.descriptionEn: Inflict maximum devastation with this massive Grineer trident.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Duviri/Dax/Weapons/.descriptionZh: （英文：SYDON）这柄沉重的 Grineer 三叉戟能造成极致的毁灭。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Duviri/Dragon/Groun.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CrpBfgName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Duviri/Dragon/Groun.descriptionEn: Once charged this Corpus laser cannon dispatches a devastating blast of light energy.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Duviri/Dragon/Groun.descriptionZh: （英文：OPTICOR ）一旦这挺 Corpus 激光炮充能完毕，便能释放出毁灭性的光能爆炸。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Duviri/PaxDuviricus.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/RVDarkDaggerName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Duviri/PaxDuviricus.descriptionEn: Infiltrate undetected; reduced visibility when held. Then strike with confidence; hits to irradiated targets restores shields and creates overshields.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Duviri/PaxDuviricus.descriptionZh: （英文：RAKTA DARK DAGGER）隐蔽入侵：持取时降低自身可见度。紧接着挥出自信一击：击中被辐射的目标可以恢复护盾并产生过载护盾。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Duviri/Weapons/Duvi.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerStaffName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Duviri/Weapons/Duvi.descriptionEn: Fashioned with Grineer materials and balanced for marine infantry use, the Amphis is a traditional staff weapon that has received a monstrous makeover that enables shock damage on jump attacks. Connects with multiple enemies with each strike.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Duviri/Weapons/Duvi.descriptionZh: （英文：AMPHIS）以 Grineer 材料制成，设计为海军陆战队使用，双头蛇是一把为了附带电击伤害而接受了大幅改造的传统棍棒武器——跳跃攻击附带电击伤害。可以同时打击多个敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Duviri/Weapons/Duvi.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerM16RifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Duviri/Weapons/Duvi.descriptionEn: Solid, dependable and deadly. The Karak is a standard issue rifle in many Grineer platoons.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Duviri/Weapons/Duvi.descriptionZh: （英文：KARAK）结实、可靠又致命。卡拉克是很多Grineer小队的一把标准配置步枪。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Duviri/Weapons/Duvi.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/RifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Duviri/Weapons/Duvi.descriptionEn: The Braton's high rate of fire and accuracy make it a favorite among the Tenno.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Duviri/Weapons/Duvi.descriptionZh: （英文：BRATON）布莱顿是一支自动步枪。高射速和高精度使其成为了 Tenno 的最爱。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Duviri/Weapons/Duvi.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerStaffName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Duviri/Weapons/Duvi.descriptionEn: Fashioned with Grineer materials and balanced for marine infantry use, the Amphis is a traditional staff weapon that has received a monstrous makeover that enables shock damage on jump attacks. Connects with multiple enemies with each strike.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Duviri/Weapons/Duvi.descriptionZh: （英文：AMPHIS）以 Grineer 材料制成，设计为海军陆战队使用，双头蛇是一把为了附带电击伤害而接受了大幅改造的传统棍棒武器——跳跃攻击附带电击伤害。可以同时打击多个敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Disruption/.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/HeavyRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Disruption/.descriptionEn: The Gorgon sports a large magazine that allows it to provide suppressing fire and sustain a high damage rate over a long time. Its high Fire Rate is only achieved following a short wind-up cycle.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Disruption/.descriptionZh: （英文：GORGON）蛇发女妖是一把重机枪。巨大的弹匣使它能够提供压制火力并长时间维持高伤害率。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Disruption/.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerAssaultRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Disruption/.descriptionEn: Equipped with a huge Magazine and impressive Fire Rate, the Grakata is the preferred weapon of Grineer Lancers.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Disruption/.descriptionZh: （英文：GRAKATA）装备了巨大弹匣，拥有非凡的射速。葛拉卡达是 Grineer 枪兵的首选。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/InfestedMic.name: /Lotus/Language/ClanTech/FlameThrower
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/InfestedMic.descriptionEn: Ignis produces a stream of intense heat.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/InfestedMic.descriptionZh: （英文：IGNIS）伊格尼斯能产生一股强烈的热浪。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/InfestedMic.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerM16RifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/InfestedMic.descriptionEn: Solid, dependable and deadly. The Karak is a standard issue rifle in many Grineer platoons.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/InfestedMic.descriptionZh: （英文：KARAK）结实、可靠又致命。卡拉克是很多Grineer小队的一把标准配置步枪。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/InfestedMic.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerDoubleBarrellName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/InfestedMic.descriptionEn: Sobek is a rapid-firing Grineer shotgun that has reduced damage per shot but boasts extra large magazine capacity.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/InfestedMic.descriptionZh: （英文：SOBEK）鳄神是一把速射型 Grineer 霰弹枪，虽降低每一枪的伤害，但拥有超大弹匣容量。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/We.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/HeavyRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/We.descriptionEn: The Gorgon sports a large magazine that allows it to provide suppressing fire and sustain a high damage rate over a long time. Its high Fire Rate is only achieved following a short wind-up cycle.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/We.descriptionZh: （英文：GORGON）蛇发女妖是一把重机枪。巨大的弹匣使它能够提供压制火力并长时间维持高伤害率。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/We.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/RifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/We.descriptionEn: The Braton's high rate of fire and accuracy make it a favorite among the Tenno.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/We.descriptionZh: （英文：BRATON）布莱顿是一支自动步枪。高射速和高精度使其成为了 Tenno 的最爱。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/We.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnFourBarrelRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/We.descriptionEn: Annihilate targets with four simultaneous shots from this high-caliber Grineer rifle.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/We.descriptionZh: （英文：QUARTAKK）用这把大口径的 Grineer 步枪的 4 发同步射击来消灭目标。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/We.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrnDualFireAxeName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/We.descriptionEn: These nasty, little hatchets slice through steel as if it were flesh.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/RailJack/We.descriptionZh: （英文：TWIN BASOLK）这对棘手凶恶的小型短斧斩铁如泥，断钢如削肉。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/SpecialEven.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrnHeatGunName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/SpecialEven.descriptionEn: This particle cannon generates a condensed beam of super-heated plasma designed to melt rock to ore, and enemies to molten slag.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/SpecialEven.descriptionZh: （英文：ATOMOS）这把粒子加农炮能产生由超高温等离子体凝聚而成的射线。而这种射线可以用来冶炼矿石，也可以将敌人化为熔渣。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Veilbreaker.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/SniperRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Veilbreaker.descriptionEn: Manufactured by the Corpus, the Snipetron is a powerful and accurate rifle that sports optical zoom capabilities. Perfect for long range engagements.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Veilbreaker.descriptionZh: （英文：SNIPETRON）由 Corpus 加工，狙击特昂是一把具备变焦能力的强力精准步枪。适合远距离战斗。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/Grineer.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnHalberdName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/Grineer.descriptionEn: Slice through mobs of unruly enemies with this fierce halberd; the signature weapon of the Kuva Guardians.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/Grineer.descriptionZh: （英文：KESHEG）用这柄凶猛的长戟割开群魔乱舞的敌人；这是赤毒守卫者标志性的武器。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/Hek/Wea.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/TennoRevolverName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/Hek/Wea.descriptionEn: Steady and reliable, the Vasto revolver combines speed and power for a classic gunslinger feel.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/Hek/Wea.descriptionZh: （英文：VASTO）稳定、可靠。这把瓦斯托左轮手枪结合了速度与力量，呈现出经典的神枪手意象。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/Jetpack.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/SniperRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/Jetpack.descriptionEn: Manufactured by the Corpus, the Snipetron is a powerful and accurate rifle that sports optical zoom capabilities. Perfect for long range engagements.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/Jetpack.descriptionZh: （英文：SNIPETRON）由 Corpus 加工，狙击特昂是一把具备变焦能力的强力精准步枪。适合远距离战斗。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/SargasR.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/VorPistolName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/SargasR.descriptionEn: Captain Vor's prized Orokin-Grineer hybrid pistol has an average rate of fire, but it has high damage and superior zoom capabilities.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/SargasR.descriptionZh: （英文：SEER）奥罗金-Grineer 复合式手枪是沃尔上尉最重要的手枪，虽只有一般射速，但具有高杀伤力和卓越的狙击能力。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/Teshin/.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/TennoShurikenName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/Teshin/.descriptionEn: As an alternative to Kunai, these Tenno throwing stars do cause less Damage but they come with expanded Ammo Capacity and a higher Fire Rate.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/Teshin/.descriptionZh: （英文：HIKOU）作为苦无的替代方案，飞扬用较低的伤害换得更高的携带量跟更快的射速。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/VorRewo.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CronusSwordName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/VorRewo.descriptionEn: A strong blade forged using ceramic.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/VorRewo.descriptionZh: （英文：CRONUS）一把用陶瓷打造的强大长剑。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/VorRewo.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerHeavyPistolName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/VorRewo.descriptionEn: The Kraken is a heavy pistol of Grineer design that fires two quick shots with a single pull of the trigger. Skilled marksmen will appreciate the value in this deadly accurate weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/VorRewo.descriptionZh: （英文：KRAKEN）北海巨妖是一把由 Grineer 设计、手感沉重的手枪，单扣扳机可迅速击出两连发射击。熟练的神枪手一定懂得这把致命精准武器的价值。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/VorRewo.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerHeavyPistolName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/VorRewo.descriptionEn: The Kraken is a heavy pistol of Grineer design that fires two quick shots with a single pull of the trigger. Skilled marksmen will appreciate the value in this deadly accurate weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Vip/VorRewo.descriptionZh: （英文：KRAKEN）北海巨妖是一把由 Grineer 设计、手感沉重的手枪，单扣扳机可迅速击出两连发射击。熟练的神枪手一定懂得这把致命精准武器的价值。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Zariman/Wea.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaKarakName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Zariman/Wea.descriptionEn: The custom weapon of a fearsome Kuva Lich. It has greater reload speed, lower recoil and greater accuracy than the standard-issue Karak rifle.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Grineer/Zariman/Wea.descriptionZh: （英文：KUVA KARAK）某位可怕的赤毒玄骸所使用的改装武器。相比于原版卡拉克步枪，它拥有更快的装填速度、更低的后座力以及更高的精准度。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/HindName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.descriptionEn: A powerful mid-range rifle used by Grineer shock troops, the Hind fires in five round bursts.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.descriptionZh: （英文：HIND）由 Grineer 突击部队使用的强力中阶步枪，雌鹿一次射击就是五连发。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.name: /Lotus/Language/ClanTech/FlameThrower
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.descriptionEn: Ignis produces a stream of intense heat.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.descriptionZh: （英文：IGNIS）伊格尼斯能产生一股强烈的热浪。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/RifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.descriptionEn: The Braton's high rate of fire and accuracy make it a favorite among the Tenno.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.descriptionZh: （英文：BRATON）布莱顿是一支自动步枪。高射速和高精度使其成为了 Tenno 的最爱。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerFlakCannonName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.descriptionEn: The Drakgoon flak cannon sends volleys of intensely hot shrapnel ricocheting around the room. Can be fired in wide or concentrated bursts.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.descriptionZh: （英文：DRAKGOON）龙骑兵破片炮可击发出会四处弹射的高热弹片。能以散射或压缩集中的方式进行射击。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/ShotgunName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.descriptionEn: The Strun is a standard shotgun. Reliable, versatile and deadly.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.descriptionZh: （英文：STRUN）斯特朗是一把标准的霰弹枪，可靠，灵活，致命。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/TwinGrakatasName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.descriptionEn: When one Grakata isn't enough, bring another for extra firepower.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.descriptionZh: （英文：TWIN GRAKATAS）一把葛拉卡达手枪不敷需求时，不妨再带上一把享受额外的火力吧。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/HindName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.descriptionEn: A powerful mid-range rifle used by Grineer shock troops, the Hind fires in five round bursts.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.descriptionZh: （英文：HIND）由 Grineer 突击部队使用的强力中阶步枪，雌鹿一次射击就是五连发。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CrpBfgName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.descriptionEn: Once charged this Corpus laser cannon dispatches a devastating blast of light energy.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.descriptionZh: （英文：OPTICOR ）一旦这挺 Corpus 激光炮充能完毕，便能释放出毁灭性的光能爆炸。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CrpBfgName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.descriptionEn: Once charged this Corpus laser cannon dispatches a devastating blast of light energy.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.descriptionZh: （英文：OPTICOR ）一旦这挺 Corpus 激光炮充能完毕，便能释放出毁灭性的光能爆炸。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCombatKnifeName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.descriptionEn: Built for close combat, the Sheev's plasma blade slices through flesh and armor with equal ease.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/GrineerChampions/Ch.descriptionZh: （英文：SHEEV）专为近身战斗设计，希芙的等离子刀刃能轻而易举切开肉体与护甲。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Wea.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/HeliosGlaiveWeaponName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Wea.descriptionEn: Causes the Helios Sentinel to attack enemy targets using pieces of itself.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/AiWeek/Wea.descriptionZh: （英文：DECONSTRUCTOR）赫利俄斯用自己身上的部件攻击目标敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/Eidolon/Go.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/VorPistolName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/Eidolon/Go.descriptionEn: Captain Vor's prized Orokin-Grineer hybrid pistol has an average rate of fire, but it has high damage and superior zoom capabilities.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/Eidolon/Go.descriptionZh: （英文：SEER）奥罗金-Grineer 复合式手枪是沃尔上尉最重要的手枪，虽只有一般射速，但具有高杀伤力和卓越的狙击能力。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/Eidolon/Go.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerHeavyPistolName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/Eidolon/Go.descriptionEn: The Kraken is a heavy pistol of Grineer design that fires two quick shots with a single pull of the trigger. Skilled marksmen will appreciate the value in this deadly accurate weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/Eidolon/Go.descriptionZh: （英文：KRAKEN）北海巨妖是一把由 Grineer 设计、手感沉重的手枪，单扣扳机可迅速击出两连发射击。熟练的神枪手一定懂得这把致命精准武器的价值。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/BeamWeaponName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionEn: Therma is a short range weapon that deals a constant stream of damage.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/InfestedMi.descriptionZh: THERMA 是一把持续输出伤害的短程武器。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/SpecialEve.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/TnoTonfaName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/SpecialEve.descriptionEn: The Kronen resurrects a lethal fighting style once thought lost to the ages.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/SpecialEve.descriptionZh: （英文：KRONEN）皇家拐刃重现了一度被认为已失落于长久岁月中的致命战斗风格。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/SpecialEve.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/TnoTonfaName

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/SpecialEve.descriptionZh: （英文：KRONEN）皇家拐刃重现了一度被认为已失落于长久岁月中的致命战斗风格。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/SpecialEve.name: /Lotus/Language/ClanTech/Torid
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/SpecialEve.descriptionZh: （英文：TORID）托里德能抛射出剧毒榴弹。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Infested/Vip/GolemF.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/VorPistolName

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/ManInTheWall/Necram.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/ThanoTechGrenadeLauncherName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/ManInTheWall/Necram.descriptionEn: Blast through enemies with a double-barreled shot of energized slugs. This siphons their life essence which is then used to generate the secondary fire's massive air-burst mortar. The ancient Entrati weapon was built for Necramechs but also functions as an Archgun.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/ManInTheWall/Necram.descriptionZh: （英文：MORGHA）通过双管射出的充能弹头来轰击敌人。这会吸取他们的生命精华，然后将其用于生成次要射击的大规模空爆迫击炮。这件古老的英择谛武器是为殁世机甲打造的，但也可以作为一把曲翼枪械来使用。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Deacon/Deaco.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnPriestSpearGunName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Deacon/Deaco.descriptionEn: Blast targets with corrosive plasma projectiles, or toss the scepter to inflict an energy field upon nearby enemies that amplifies their brain waves to attract bullets.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Deacon/Deaco.descriptionZh: （英文：SCOURGE）用腐蚀性的等离子体轰炸目标，或是投出手杖用能量场增幅附近敌人的脑波，使其吸引子弹。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusHandCannonName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.descriptionEn: The sleek lines of the Detron conceal its ferocious nature. The hand cannon's semi-automatic action takes down enemies with speed and efficiency.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.descriptionZh: （英文：DETRON）德特昂的流线型线条掩饰其凶残本性，这把半自动手枪是快速并有效率地击倒敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/RifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.descriptionEn: The Braton's high rate of fire and accuracy make it a favorite among the Tenno.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.descriptionZh: （英文：BRATON）布莱顿是一支自动步枪。高射速和高精度使其成为了 Tenno 的最爱。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.name: /Lotus/Language/ClanTech/FlameThrower
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.descriptionEn: Ignis produces a stream of intense heat.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.descriptionZh: （英文：IGNIS）伊格尼斯能产生一股强烈的热浪。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrnDualFireAxeName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.descriptionEn: These nasty, little hatchets slice through steel as if it were flesh.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.descriptionZh: （英文：TWIN BASOLK）这对棘手凶恶的小型短斧斩铁如泥，断钢如削肉。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/SniperRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.descriptionEn: Manufactured by the Corpus, the Snipetron is a powerful and accurate rifle that sports optical zoom capabilities. Perfect for long range engagements.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.descriptionZh: （英文：SNIPETRON）由 Corpus 加工，狙击特昂是一把具备变焦能力的强力精准步枪。适合远距离战斗。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/HeavyRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.descriptionEn: The Gorgon sports a large magazine that allows it to provide suppressing fire and sustain a high damage rate over a long time. Its high Fire Rate is only achieved following a short wind-up cycle.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.descriptionZh: （英文：GORGON）蛇发女妖是一把重机枪。巨大的弹匣使它能够提供压制火力并长时间维持高伤害率。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/HeavyRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.descriptionEn: The Gorgon sports a large magazine that allows it to provide suppressing fire and sustain a high damage rate over a long time. Its high Fire Rate is only achieved following a short wind-up cycle.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.descriptionZh: （英文：GORGON）蛇发女妖是一把重机枪。巨大的弹匣使它能够提供压制火力并长时间维持高伤害率。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerDoubleBarrellName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.descriptionEn: Sobek is a rapid-firing Grineer shotgun that has reduced damage per shot but boasts extra large magazine capacity.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.descriptionZh: （英文：SOBEK）鳄神是一把速射型 Grineer 霰弹枪，虽降低每一枪的伤害，但拥有超大弹匣容量。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/RifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.descriptionEn: The Braton's high rate of fire and accuracy make it a favorite among the Tenno.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.descriptionZh: （英文：BRATON）布莱顿是一支自动步枪。高射速和高精度使其成为了 Tenno 的最爱。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/BurstPistolName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.descriptionEn: The Sicarus fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of auto-pistols and the accuracy of semi-automatic pistols.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.descriptionZh: （英文：SICARUS）暗杀者是三发点射手枪，在连发手枪的杀伤力和单发手枪的准确度之间取得平衡。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/ShotgunName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.descriptionEn: The Strun is a standard shotgun. Reliable, versatile and deadly.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.descriptionZh: （英文：STRUN）斯特朗是一把标准的霰弹枪，可靠，灵活，致命。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/RifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.descriptionEn: The Braton's high rate of fire and accuracy make it a favorite among the Tenno.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.name: /Lotus/Language/ClanTech/CrpHeavyRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.descriptionEn: The SUPRA is a heavy laser gun with a short wind up time.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Narmer/Weapons/Narm.descriptionZh: （英文：SUPRA）苏普拉是把重型激光枪，可在很短的时间内启动。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NewWar/Archons/AiAr.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/ArchonDualDaggersName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NewWar/Archons/AiAr.descriptionEn: The dual flaming fang-blades of the Archon Amar. Has a unique Neutral Combo that blasts out four short-range fireballs.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NewWar/Archons/AiAr.descriptionZh: （英文：NEPHERI）执刑官欺谋狼主的烈焰双刃。其独特的近战组合可以发射四个短程火球。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NewWar/Archons/AiBo.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/ChainLightningRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NewWar/Archons/AiBo.descriptionEn: The Amprex rifle fires a continuous beam of high voltage electricity that arcs among nearby enemies. This weapon excels at Crowd Control.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NewWar/Archons/AiBo.descriptionZh: （英文：AMPREX）安培克斯步枪可持续发射致命电光束并在敌人中形成电弧。这件武器在群体控制方面很优秀。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NewWar/Archons/AiPN.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/ArchonWhipName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NewWar/Archons/AiPN.descriptionEn: Archon Nira’s spine-shattering whip. Has a unique Tactical Combo that whips out a wide wave of energy with each stroke.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NewWar/Archons/AiPN.descriptionZh: （英文：VERDILAC）执刑官混沌蛇主的刺骨长鞭。其独特的战术组合每次抽击时都会掀起巨大的能量波。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NewWar/Archons/Bore.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/ChainLightningRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NewWar/Archons/Bore.descriptionEn: The Amprex rifle fires a continuous beam of high voltage electricity that arcs among nearby enemies. This weapon excels at Crowd Control.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NewWar/Archons/Bore.descriptionZh: （英文：AMPREX）安培克斯步枪可持续发射致命电光束并在敌人中形成电弧。这件武器在群体控制方面很优秀。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NewWar/Archons/Nira.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CrpAirPistolArrayName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NewWar/Archons/Nira.descriptionEn: Blasts targets with a massive wave of sonic energy. Results reported to be: 'Very Satisfying'.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NewWar/Archons/Nira.descriptionZh: （英文：SONICOR）以巨大的声波能量震飞目标。使用报告的结果是：非常爽。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBlastorWeaponName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.descriptionEn: Cultivate a meaningful relationship with this deceptively simple battery-powered pistol. The Plinx rewards attention and investment from the wise.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.descriptionZh: （英文：PLINX）与这把看似朴素的电池手枪培养出深厚的情感。漫射者最能回馈来自智者的关注与投资。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusMinigunName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.descriptionEn: Compact and deadly, the Cestra discharges bolts of energy at an increasingly rapid rate.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.descriptionZh: （英文：CESTRA）小巧而致命的锡斯特，以越来越快的射速释放能量弹。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusUMPName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.descriptionEn: Drawing from its huge quad-chambered magazine, the Tetra is capable of unleashing a sustained barrage of lethal energy bolts.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.descriptionZh: （英文：TETRA）借由它巨大的四腔弹匣，特拉能持续发射由能量弹形成的致命弹幕。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpShapeBlastName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.descriptionEn: Feel the kick of this Corpus shotgun as it shatters a high-yield crystal into anyone and anything standing in your way.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.descriptionZh: （英文：EXERGIS）当这把 Corpus 霰弹枪将高产水晶轰入阻挡在你前方的任何人或物时，请细细品味其后坐力。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpHammerShieldName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.descriptionEn: Drive the agenda with this massive impact hammer. Heavy attacks launch devastating energy disks.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.descriptionZh: （英文：TENET AGENDUS）用这把重型冲击锤推动议程。重击会发射毁灭性的能量盘。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/SniperRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.descriptionEn: Manufactured by the Corpus, the Snipetron is a powerful and accurate rifle that sports optical zoom capabilities. Perfect for long range engagements.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.descriptionZh: （英文：SNIPETRON）由 Corpus 加工，狙击特昂是一把具备变焦能力的强力精准步枪。适合远距离战斗。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CrpBfgName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.descriptionEn: Once charged this Corpus laser cannon dispatches a devastating blast of light energy.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.descriptionZh: （英文：OPTICOR ）一旦这挺 Corpus 激光炮充能完毕，便能释放出毁灭性的光能爆炸。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpShotgunName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.descriptionEn: Stagger targets with blasts from this Corpus engineered plasma shotgun. Surviving enemies are consumed with radiation.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.descriptionZh: （英文：ARCA PLASMOR）用这把 Corpus 设计的等离子霰弹枪来击倒你的目标。幸存下来的敌人会被辐射耗尽生命。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/KuvaNukorName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.descriptionEn: A highly-optimized Nukor that allows for the weapon’s microwave field to hit up to two additional targets.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.descriptionZh: （英文：KUVA NUKOR）一把高度优化的努寇微波枪，可以通过其微波场击中最多两个额外目标。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.name: /Lotus/Language/ClanTech/CrpHeavyRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/NokkoColony/Weapons.descriptionEn: The SUPRA is a heavy laser gun with a short wind up time.

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/Entrati/Entr.name: /Lotus/Language/Necromech/MechNecroTechMeleeName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/Entrati/Entr.descriptionEn: The Necramech's graspers can deliver a powerful punch.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/Entrati/Entr.descriptionZh: 殁世机甲的抓钳可以提供强力猛击。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/Entrati/Entr.name: /Lotus/Language/Necromech/MechNecroTechMeleeName

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/Entrati/Entr.name: /Lotus/Language/Necromech/MechNecroTechExaltedSwordName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/Entrati/Entr.descriptionEn: A titanic blade modeled after some of the very oldest swords, this weapon was designed to slice through massed enemy troops in a single stroke.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/Entrati/Entr.descriptionZh: （英文：IRONBRIDE）一把灵感源自最古老刀剑的巨大利刃，这把武器是为了一次性击穿大量敌人而设计的。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/Entrati/Entr.name: /Lotus/Language/Necromech/MechNecroTechMeleeName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/Entrati/Entr.descriptionEn: The Necramech's graspers can deliver a powerful punch.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/Entrati/Entr.descriptionZh: 殁世机甲的抓钳可以提供强力猛击。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/Entrati/Entr.name: /Lotus/Language/Necromech/MechNecroTechMeleeName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/Entrati/Entr.descriptionEn: The Necramech's graspers can deliver a powerful punch.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/Entrati/Entr.descriptionZh: 殁世机甲的抓钳可以提供强力猛击。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/Weapons/Lase.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/ShotgunName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/Weapons/Lase.descriptionEn: The Strun is a standard shotgun. Reliable, versatile and deadly.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Orokin/Weapons/Lase.descriptionZh: （英文：STRUN）斯特朗是一把标准的霰弹枪，可靠，灵活，致命。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Quests/SacrificeQue.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/FistName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Quests/SacrificeQue.descriptionEn: These power gauntlets lack the range of most Melee Weapons, but Furax is far more devastating when you strike an enemy in close combat.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Quests/SacrificeQue.descriptionZh: （英文：FURAX）这动力拳套较大部分近战武器距离更短，但在近战中表现更为优秀。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Brachioly.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/RifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Brachioly.descriptionEn: The Braton's high rate of fire and accuracy make it a favorite among the Tenno.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Sentients/Brachioly.descriptionZh: （英文：BRATON）布莱顿是一支自动步枪。高射速和高精度使其成为了 Tenno 的最爱。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Primes/Volt/Vol.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/PrimeCorvasName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Primes/Volt/Vol.descriptionEn: Flaunting ceremonial beauty, this arch gun flak cannon is even more devastating than its standard issue counterpart.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Primes/Volt/Vol.descriptionZh: （英文：CORVAS PRIME）招摇又考究的美人，这款曲翼枪械版高射炮比其标准版更具破坏性。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Uriel/UrielBayo.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnBayonetPrimaryWeaponName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Uriel/UrielBayo.descriptionEn: Bring hell to the battlefield with Uriel's signature rifle and bayonet combination. Occupying both primary and melee slots, this unique weapon blends precision marksmanship with unrelenting melee combat.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/Tau/Uriel/UrielBayo.descriptionZh: （英文：VINQUIBUS）通过 Uriel 的标志性步枪和刺刀组合，将地狱之火带入战场。这把独特的武器既可作为主要武器也可作为近战武器，完美融合了精准的射击和毫不留情的近战攻击。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Fai.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/DualKamasName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Fai.descriptionEn: Wielding a Kama in each hand brings a savage amount of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage to bear against your enemies.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Fai.descriptionZh: （英文：DUAL KAMAS）两手各挥舞一把短柄战镰产生野蛮的<DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害来对抗敌人。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Fai.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/HuntingBowName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Fai.descriptionEn: Based on one of the world's oldest weapon designs, this Tenno-crafted weapon can be used both in stealth and in open combat. The Paris uses a chargeable magnetic field to launch arrows capable of impaling enemies to walls.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Fai.descriptionZh: （英文：PARIS）以世界最古老的武器设计为基础，Tenno 所制作的武器不论隐匿行动和交火接战均可使用。帕里斯可利用磁场蓄力，其射出的箭矢足以将敌人钉在墙上。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Fai.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/LongSwordName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Fai.descriptionEn: Before all other weapons, Tenno master the Skana. This simple blade becomes immensely powerful in the hands of a master. For Tenno, it is the foundation of their fighting style and a pillar of their culture.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Fai.descriptionZh: （英文：SKANA）Tenno 在各种武器之中，最先精通的是空刃。其朴素的刀刃在他们手中是无比的强大。对Tenno 来说，这是他们战斗的基础以及文化的支柱。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Fai.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/TnoKrisKnifeName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Fai.descriptionEn: Once the blade weapon of choice for an exclusive order of Tenno assassins, the Karyst dagger grew to become a symbol of honor and duty for all Tenno.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Fai.descriptionZh: （英文：KARYST）这曾是一个门第严格的 Tenno 刺客工会的特制武器，凯洛斯特匕首后来渐渐成为了所有 Tenno 的荣耀与使命的象征。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Fai.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/RepeatingCrossbowName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Fai.descriptionEn: This devastating automatic crossbow is the perfect marriage of ancient Earth weaponry and Tenno technology.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Fai.descriptionZh: （英文：ZHUGE）这把毁灭性的自动连弩是古代地球军武与 Tenno 工艺完美结合的杰作。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Oda.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnOdaliskSmgPistolName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Oda.descriptionEn: With a high fire rate, ammo efficiency and rapid reload when emptied, this unusual sidearm can hand out carnage all day long. Ammo efficiency is further increased when Protea uses this, her signature weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Oda.descriptionZh: （英文：VELOX）在高射速、高弹药效率以及高装填速度的加持下，这把非比寻常的次要武器能昼夜无休地大杀四方。作为 Protea 的标志性武器，弹药效率会在 Protea 使用它时更进一步地提升。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CrpAirPistolArrayName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.descriptionEn: Blasts targets with a massive wave of sonic energy. Results reported to be: 'Very Satisfying'.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.descriptionZh: （英文：SONICOR）以巨大的声波能量震飞目标。使用报告的结果是：非常爽。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CrpAirPistolArrayName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.descriptionEn: Blasts targets with a massive wave of sonic energy. Results reported to be: 'Very Satisfying'.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Ora.descriptionZh: （英文：SONICOR）以巨大的声波能量震飞目标。使用报告的结果是：非常爽。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Rel.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/StartingRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Rel.descriptionEn: The MK1-Braton is the standard issue rifle for all Tenno. A versatile weapon that can be customized to support a wide variety of play styles.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Rel.descriptionZh: （英文：MK1-BRATON）MK1-布莱顿是 Tenno 的标准配置步枪，是一把可被定制化以支援各种使用风格的多功能武器。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Rel.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/TennoShurikenName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Rel.descriptionEn: As an alternative to Kunai, these Tenno throwing stars do cause less Damage but they come with expanded Ammo Capacity and a higher Fire Rate.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Rel.descriptionZh: （英文：HIKOU）作为苦无的替代方案，飞扬用较低的伤害换得更高的携带量跟更快的射速。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Rel.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/TennoAssaultRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Rel.descriptionEn: Accuracy coupled with a massive magazine makes the Soma assault rifle a formidable weapon.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Rel.descriptionZh: （英文：SOMA）高准度与高容量弹匣的结合，使月神突击步枪成为强大的武器。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Rel.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/SomaDualKamasName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Rel.descriptionEn: Razor sharp battle-hatchets, designed to compliment the Soma.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Rel.descriptionZh: （英文：DUAL RAZA）这组锐利战斧是为了配合月神而设计的。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Rel.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/HuntingBowName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Rel.descriptionEn: Based on one of the world's oldest weapon designs, this Tenno-crafted weapon can be used both in stealth and in open combat. The Paris uses a chargeable magnetic field to launch arrows capable of impaling enemies to walls.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Rel.descriptionZh: （英文：PARIS）以世界最古老的武器设计为基础，Tenno 所制作的武器不论隐匿行动和交火接战均可使用。帕里斯可利用磁场蓄力，其射出的箭矢足以将敌人钉在墙上。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Rel.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/SingleStaffName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Rel.descriptionEn: A lone Tenno once used this staff to fight back a horde of Infested.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Rel.descriptionZh: （英文：CADUS）曾经有一名孤身一人的 Tenno 以这柄单手杖击退了一整个群落的感染者。

/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Syn.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusUMPName
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Syn.descriptionEn: Drawing from its huge quad-chambered magazine, the Tetra is capable of unleashing a sustained barrage of lethal energy bolts.
/Lotus/Types/Enemies/TennoReplicants/Syn.descriptionZh: （英文：TETRA）借由它巨大的四腔弹匣，特拉能持续发射由能量弹形成的致命弹幕。

/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/NewWar/BallasSpear.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/ChainLightningRifleName
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/NewWar/BallasSpear.descriptionEn: The Amprex rifle fires a continuous beam of high voltage electricity that arcs among nearby enemies. This weapon excels at Crowd Control.
/Lotus/Types/Gameplay/NewWar/BallasSpear.descriptionZh: （英文：AMPREX）安培克斯步枪可持续发射致命电光束并在敌人中形成电弧。这件武器在群体控制方面很优秀。

/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/S.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/SentElecRailgunName
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/S.descriptionEn: Standard issue sniper rifle for Diriga.
/Lotus/Types/Sentinels/SentinelWeapons/S.descriptionZh: （英文：VULKLOK）电气浮囊的标准狙击枪。

/Lotus/Upgrades/Mods/Aura/EnemyElectrici.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/PlayerMeleeBuffElectrictyName
/Lotus/Upgrades/Mods/Aura/EnemyElectrici.descriptionZh: 在近战武器上附加<DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害

/Lotus/Weapons/Archon/Melee/DualDaggers/.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/ArchonDualDaggersName
/Lotus/Weapons/Archon/Melee/DualDaggers/.descriptionEn: The dual flaming fang-blades of the Archon Amar. Has a unique Neutral Combo that blasts out four short-range fireballs.
/Lotus/Weapons/Archon/Melee/DualDaggers/.descriptionZh: （英文：NEPHERI）执刑官欺谋狼主的烈焰双刃。其独特的近战组合可以发射四个短程火球。

/Lotus/Weapons/Archon/Melee/Whip/ArchonW.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/ArchonWhipName
/Lotus/Weapons/Archon/Melee/Whip/ArchonW.descriptionEn: Archon Nira’s spine-shattering whip. Has a unique Tactical Combo that whips out a wide wave of energy with each stroke.
/Lotus/Weapons/Archon/Melee/Whip/ArchonW.descriptionZh: （英文：VERDILAC）执刑官混沌蛇主的刺骨长鞭。其独特的战术组合每次抽击时都会掀起巨大的能量波。

/Lotus/Weapons/CaptureTargetWeapons/Capt.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusHandCannonName
/Lotus/Weapons/CaptureTargetWeapons/Capt.descriptionEn: The sleek lines of the Detron conceal its ferocious nature. The hand cannon's semi-automatic action takes down enemies with speed and efficiency.
/Lotus/Weapons/CaptureTargetWeapons/Capt.descriptionZh: （英文：DETRON）德特昂的流线型线条掩饰其凶残本性，这把半自动手枪是快速并有效率地击倒敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/CaptureTargetWeapons/Capt.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/BurstPistolName
/Lotus/Weapons/CaptureTargetWeapons/Capt.descriptionEn: The Sicarus fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of auto-pistols and the accuracy of semi-automatic pistols.
/Lotus/Weapons/CaptureTargetWeapons/Capt.descriptionZh: （英文：SICARUS）暗杀者是三发点射手枪，在连发手枪的杀伤力和单发手枪的准确度之间取得平衡。

/Lotus/Weapons/CaptureTargetWeapons/Capt.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/BurstPistolName

/Lotus/Weapons/CaptureTargetWeapons/Capt.descriptionEn: The Kraken is a heavy pistol of Grineer design that fires two quick shots with a single pull of the trigger. Skilled marksmen will appreciate the value in this deadly accurate weapon.
/Lotus/Weapons/CaptureTargetWeapons/Capt.descriptionZh: （英文：KRAKEN）北海巨妖是一把由 Grineer 设计、手感沉重的手枪，单扣扳机可迅速击出两连发射击。熟练的神枪手一定懂得这把致命精准武器的价值。

/Lotus/Weapons/CaptureTargetWeapons/Capt.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerSawbladeGunName
/Lotus/Weapons/CaptureTargetWeapons/Capt.descriptionEn: The Miter launches high velocity saw blades, tearing apart anyone unfortunate enough to be in their path.
/Lotus/Weapons/CaptureTargetWeapons/Capt.descriptionZh: （英文：MITER）米特尔发射高速锯片，撕裂任何不幸在其路径上的人。

/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Bio/BioWeapon.name: /Lotus/Language/ClanTech/Torid
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Bio/BioWeapon.descriptionZh: （英文：TORID）托里德能抛射出剧毒榴弹。

/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/AICrpLase.descriptionEn: Laser Rifle with Corpus safe-guards removed.
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/AICrpLase.descriptionZh: （英文：FLUX RIFLE）一把已卸除了 Corpus 安全装置的激光步枪。

/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/CrpLaserP.name: /Lotus/Language/ClanTech/SpectraCorpusLaserPistolName
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/CrpLaserP.descriptionEn: While its intended design is for deep space construction, the concentrated laser beam of the Spectra is highly effective against organic and synthetic enemies.
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/CrpLaserP.descriptionZh: （英文：SPECTRA）虽然它原本设计给太空中的工程师，光谱切割器的集中激光对有机和合成敌人也非常有效。

/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/Railgun.name: /Lotus/Language/ClanTech/Railgun
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/Railgun.descriptionEn: The Lanka fires a high velocity projectile through magnetic induction.
/Lotus/Weapons/ClanTech/Energy/Railgun.descriptionZh: （英文：LANKA）兰卡使用电磁加速射出高速子弹。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpArSnip.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpArSniperName
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpArSnip.descriptionEn: Bring negotiations to an instant conclusion with this Corpus assault rifle. Switch effortlessly between charged explosive shots and rapid-fire electrical assault mode.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpArSnip.descriptionZh: （英文：AMBASSADOR）使用这支 Corpus 突击步枪让谈判立即结束。可以在充能爆炸狙击和速射电子突击模式之间自由切换。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpEnergy.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CrpAirPistolArrayName
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpEnergy.descriptionEn: Blasts targets with a massive wave of sonic energy. Results reported to be: 'Very Satisfying'.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpEnergy.descriptionZh: （英文：SONICOR）以巨大的声波能量震飞目标。使用报告的结果是：非常爽。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpFreeze.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CrpFreezeRayRifleName
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpFreeze.descriptionEn: Fires a photon beam that halts molecular vibrations, causing instant and painful freezing.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpFreeze.descriptionZh: （英文：GLAXION）发射出一道能暂停分子振动的光子束，造成痛苦的瞬间冻结。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpShapeB.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpShapeBlastName
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpShapeB.descriptionEn: Feel the kick of this Corpus shotgun as it shatters a high-yield crystal into anyone and anything standing in your way.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/CrpShapeB.descriptionZh: （英文：EXERGIS）当这把 Corpus 霰弹枪将高产水晶轰入阻挡在你前方的任何人或物时，请细细品味其后坐力。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/GrenadeLa.name: /Lotus/Language/ClanTech/GrenadeLauncherName
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/GrenadeLa.descriptionEn: The Penta Launcher fires up to five grenades that can be remotely triggered at just the right moment.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/GrenadeLa.descriptionZh: （英文：PENTA）潘塔发射器最多可发射五发榴弹，并在最适当的时候进行远距离引爆。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/GrenadeLa.name: /Lotus/Language/ClanTech/GrenadeLauncherName
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/GrenadeLa.descriptionEn: The Penta Launcher fires up to five grenades that can be remotely triggered at just the right moment.

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/Machinegu.descriptionEn: A customized version of the powerful Supra, featuring a metallic finish and Lotus decal.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/Machinegu.descriptionZh: （英文：SUPRA VANDAL）强力苏普拉的定制版本，拥有着金属质感及 Lotus 的徽记。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/VenusAnti.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/RifleName
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/VenusAnti.descriptionEn: The Braton's high rate of fire and accuracy make it a favorite among the Tenno.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/VenusAnti.descriptionZh: （英文：BRATON）布莱顿是一支自动步枪。高射速和高精度使其成为了 Tenno 的最爱。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/VenusAnti.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/RifleName

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/VenusHeav.descriptionEn: An Archwing energy weapon that sends waves of deadly plasma crashing into enemies.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/LongGuns/VenusHeav.descriptionZh: （英文：FLUCTUS）一把能射出致命等离子波来击溃敌人的曲翼能量武器。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CorpusHand.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CorpusHandCannonName
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CorpusHand.descriptionEn: The sleek lines of the Detron conceal its ferocious nature. The hand cannon's semi-automatic action takes down enemies with speed and efficiency.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CorpusHand.descriptionZh: （英文：DETRON）德特昂的流线型线条掩饰其凶残本性，这把半自动手枪是快速并有效率地击倒敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CorpusMini.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/DualCorpusMinigunName
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CorpusMini.descriptionEn: Wield two Cestras to unleash a dual torrent of high energy bolts.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CorpusMini.descriptionZh: （英文：DUAL CESTRA）双手各持一把锡斯特释放出双流高能量弹幕。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpSentAma.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpSentAmlgPistolName
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpSentAma.descriptionEn: Sentient tech merges with Corpus design to deliver this lethal sidearm. Fully automatic, it fires ricocheting, homing projectiles that release small clouds of <DT_GAS_COLOR>Gas on impact. Alt-fire to release the entire magazine without homing as a single burst.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpSentAma.descriptionZh: （英文：CYANEX）Sentient 科技与 Corpus 设计的结合，发展出这款致命的次要武器。该武器为全自动，可射出跳飞式、自动导引的弹幕，子弹在撞击时会释放出小一股 <DT_GAS_COLOR>毒气。次要射击为可在单次射击中释放剩余的弹药。

/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpSonific.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/CrpBlastorWeaponName
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpSonific.descriptionEn: Cultivate a meaningful relationship with this deceptively simple battery-powered pistol. The Plinx rewards attention and investment from the wise.
/Lotus/Weapons/Corpus/Pistols/CrpSonific.descriptionZh: （英文：PLINX）与这把看似朴素的电池手枪培养出深厚的情感。漫射者最能回馈来自智者的关注与投资。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/DeathSquadWeapons.descriptionEn: The Hek is a powerful shotgun that fires its shots with a tight spread, making it efficient at medium range as long as its strong recoil is properly managed.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/DeathSquadWeapons.descriptionZh: （英文：HEK）海克是一把能发射密集弹丸的强力霰弹枪，只要能驾驭其猛烈后坐力，在中距离战斗也能有效发挥。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/DeathSquadWeapons.descriptionEn: Steady and reliable, the Vasto revolver combines speed and power for a classic gunslinger feel.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/DeathSquadWeapons.descriptionZh: （英文：VASTO）稳定、可靠。这把瓦斯托左轮手枪结合了速度与力量，呈现出经典的神枪手意象。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/GrnJetpackSniperR.descriptionEn: Manufactured by the Corpus, the Snipetron is a powerful and accurate rifle that sports optical zoom capabilities. Perfect for long range engagements.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/GrnJetpackSniperR.descriptionZh: （英文：SNIPETRON）由 Corpus 加工，狙击特昂是一把具备变焦能力的强力精准步枪。适合远距离战斗。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/HammerBossWeapon.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/HammerName
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/HammerBossWeapon.descriptionEn: A large two-handed hammer, the Fragor requires great strength to wield, but impacts with enough force to send groups of enemies tumbling.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/HammerBossWeapon.descriptionZh: （英文：FRAGOR）巨大的双手锤，重击巨锤拥有能将复数敌人击飞的力量。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/HeavyWeapons/GrnH.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnHeavyGrenadeLauncherName
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/HeavyWeapons/GrnH.descriptionEn: Sweep aside hordes of enemies with flaming fury of this powerful, automatic, grenade launching archgun.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/HeavyWeapons/GrnH.descriptionZh: （英文：KUVA AYANGA）用这款全自动曲翼榴弹发射器的怒火来扫荡大群敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/BurstRif.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/HindName
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/BurstRif.descriptionEn: A powerful mid-range rifle used by Grineer shock troops, the Hind fires in five round bursts.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/BurstRif.descriptionZh: （英文：HIND）由 Grineer 突击部队使用的强力中阶步枪，雌鹿一次射击就是五连发。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/BurstRif.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/HindName

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerA.descriptionEn: Equipped with a huge Magazine and impressive Fire Rate, the Grakata is the preferred weapon of Grineer Lancers.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerA.descriptionZh: （英文：GRAKATA）装备了巨大弹匣，拥有非凡的射速。葛拉卡达是 Grineer 枪兵的首选。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerF.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerFlakCannonName
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerF.descriptionEn: The Drakgoon flak cannon sends volleys of intensely hot shrapnel ricocheting around the room. Can be fired in wide or concentrated bursts.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerF.descriptionZh: （英文：DRAKGOON）龙骑兵破片炮可击发出会四处弹射的高热弹片。能以散射或压缩集中的方式进行射击。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerL.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GLARifleName
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/LongGuns/GrineerL.descriptionEn: With pinpoint accuracy, the Grinlok lever-action repeating rifle can easily find the soft spot on any target.

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerClaw.descriptionZh: （英文：TWIN BASOLK）这对棘手凶恶的小型短斧斩铁如泥，断钢如削肉。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerComb.descriptionEn: Built for close combat, the Sheev's plasma blade slices through flesh and armor with equal ease.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerComb.descriptionZh: （英文：SHEEV）专为近身战斗设计，希芙的等离子刀刃能轻而易举切开肉体与护甲。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerHeav.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerStaffName
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerHeav.descriptionEn: Fashioned with Grineer materials and balanced for marine infantry use, the Amphis is a traditional staff weapon that has received a monstrous makeover that enables shock damage on jump attacks. Connects with multiple enemies with each strike.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrineerHeav.descriptionZh: （英文：AMPHIS）以 Grineer 材料制成，设计为海军陆战队使用，双头蛇是一把为了附带电击伤害而接受了大幅改造的传统棍棒武器——跳跃攻击附带电击伤害。可以同时打击多个敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnTrident/.descriptionEn: Inflict maximum devastation with this massive Grineer trident.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Melee/GrnTrident/.descriptionZh: （英文：SYDON）这柄沉重的 Grineer 三叉戟能造成极致的毁灭。

/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrineerCr.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerGooGunName
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrineerCr.descriptionEn: Firing a sticky, toxic, explosive compound, the Stug Gel Gun offers multiple ejection modes, delivering maximum damage in all situations.
/Lotus/Weapons/Grineer/Pistols/GrineerCr.descriptionZh: （英文：STUG）史特克凝胶枪能发射出一种粘稠、有毒的爆炸混合物。且具有多种发射模式，在各种情况下都能造成最大伤害。

/Lotus/Weapons/SpaceWeapons/Corpus/Grena.descriptionZh: （英文：PENTA）潘塔发射器最多可发射五发榴弹，并在最适当的时候进行远距离引爆。

/Lotus/Weapons/SpaceWeapons/Corpus/Laser.descriptionEn: The Braton's high rate of fire and accuracy make it a favorite among the Tenno.
/Lotus/Weapons/SpaceWeapons/Corpus/Laser.descriptionZh: （英文：BRATON）布莱顿是一支自动步枪。高射速和高精度使其成为了 Tenno 的最爱。

/Lotus/Weapons/SpaceWeapons/Corpus/Shock.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CrpShockRifleName
/Lotus/Weapons/SpaceWeapons/Corpus/Shock.descriptionEn: This weapon was designed to assist with the excavation of mineral deposits from large asteroids, but has been adapted for military purposes.
/Lotus/Weapons/SpaceWeapons/Corpus/Shock.descriptionZh: （英文：QUANTA）这个武器原本是设计用来在大型小行星上协助挖掘矿物，但现在已更改为应用于军事用途上。

/Lotus/Weapons/SpaceWeapons/Corpus/Swarm.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/BeamWeaponName
/Lotus/Weapons/SpaceWeapons/Corpus/Swarm.descriptionEn: Therma is a short range weapon that deals a constant stream of damage.
/Lotus/Weapons/SpaceWeapons/Corpus/Swarm.descriptionZh: THERMA 是一把持续输出伤害的短程武器。

/Lotus/Weapons/SpaceWeapons/Grineer/Lase.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/BeamWeaponName
/Lotus/Weapons/SpaceWeapons/Grineer/Lase.descriptionEn: Therma is a short range weapon that deals a constant stream of damage.
/Lotus/Weapons/SpaceWeapons/Grineer/Lase.descriptionZh: THERMA 是一把持续输出伤害的短程武器。

/Lotus/Weapons/SpaceWeapons/Grineer/Ligh.descriptionEn: The Braton's high rate of fire and accuracy make it a favorite among the Tenno.
/Lotus/Weapons/SpaceWeapons/Grineer/Ligh.descriptionZh: （英文：BRATON）布莱顿是一支自动步枪。高射速和高精度使其成为了 Tenno 的最爱。

/Lotus/Weapons/SpaceWeapons/Grineer/Skif.descriptionEn: The Braton's high rate of fire and accuracy make it a favorite among the Tenno.
