/Lotus/Weapons/SpaceWeapons/Grineer/Spac.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/BeamWeaponName
/Lotus/Weapons/SpaceWeapons/Grineer/Spac.descriptionEn: Therma is a short range weapon that deals a constant stream of damage.
/Lotus/Weapons/SpaceWeapons/Grineer/Spac.descriptionZh: THERMA 是一把持续输出伤害的短程武器。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/ArbitersOfHexi.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/AHAkboltoName
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/ArbitersOfHexi.descriptionEn: For the Arbiters of Hexis these pistols are more than simple weapons, they are symbols of truth and discipline.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/ArbitersOfHexi.descriptionZh: （英文：TELOS AKBOLTO）对均衡仲裁者来说，这对手枪不单只是寻常的武器，它们是真相与纪律的象征。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/CephalonSuda/P.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CSReconnasorName
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/CephalonSuda/P.descriptionEn: Deployed by the Cephalon Suda, once a data-analyzing instrument the Gammacor main focus is defense.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/CephalonSuda/P.descriptionZh: （英文：SYNOID GAMMACOR）由中枢苏达所设置，过去曾作为数据分析仪器，但现在已转为专用于自卫的武器。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/NewLoka/Pistol.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/NLCastanasName
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/NewLoka/Pistol.descriptionEn: This remotely detonated electrical trap is used by devotees of New Loka to protect their temples and shrines.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/NewLoka/Pistol.descriptionZh: （英文：SANCTI CASTANAS ）这种能遥控引爆的电击陷阱是新世间的信徒用来保护他们的寺庙与圣殿的武器。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/PerrinSequence.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/PSDualCestraName
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/PerrinSequence.descriptionEn: The favored side-arms of Perrin Sequence executives, these pistols have been modified to improve efficiency and killing potential.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/PerrinSequence.descriptionZh: （英文：SECURA DUAL CESTRA）受佩兰数列高层人员青睐的贴身武器，这对手枪已经过改造来提升效率与击杀潜力。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Bows/A.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/RVCernosName
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Bows/A.descriptionEn: A finely tuned instrument of assassination.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Bows/A.descriptionZh: （英文：RAKTA CERNOS）一把精巧的刺杀工具。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Bows/A.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/RVCernosName
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Bows/A.descriptionEn: A finely tuned instrument of assassination.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Bows/A.descriptionZh: （英文：RAKTA CERNOS）一把精巧的刺杀工具。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Melee/.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/RVDarkDaggerName
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Melee/.descriptionEn: Infiltrate undetected; reduced visibility when held. Then strike with confidence; hits to irradiated targets restores shields and creates overshields.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Melee/.descriptionZh: （英文：RAKTA DARK DAGGER）隐蔽入侵：持取时降低自身可见度。紧接着挥出自信一击：击中被辐射的目标可以恢复护盾并产生过载护盾。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Melee/.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/RVDarkDaggerName
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Melee/.descriptionEn: Infiltrate undetected; reduced visibility when held. Then strike with confidence; hits to irradiated targets restores shields and creates overshields.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Melee/.descriptionZh: （英文：RAKTA DARK DAGGER）隐蔽入侵：持取时降低自身可见度。紧接着挥出自信一击：击中被辐射的目标可以恢复护盾并产生过载护盾。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Pistol.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/RVBallisticaName
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Pistol.descriptionEn: This modified ballistica is the weapon of choice used by Red Veil Assassins to take out high-priority marks.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Pistol.descriptionZh: （英文：RAKTA BALLISTICA）这把经过改造的布里斯提卡是血色面纱的刺客用来解决高度优先目标的首选武器。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Pistol.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/RVBallisticaName
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Pistol.descriptionEn: This modified ballistica is the weapon of choice used by Red Veil Assassins to take out high-priority marks.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/RedVeil/Pistol.descriptionZh: （英文：RAKTA BALLISTICA）这把经过改造的布里斯提卡是血色面纱的刺客用来解决高度优先目标的首选武器。

/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/SteelMeridian/.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/SMMarelokName
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/SteelMeridian/.descriptionEn: Taken from defeated Grineer commanders and rebuilt to improve combat efficiency and reliability.
/Lotus/Weapons/Syndicates/SteelMeridian/.descriptionZh: （英文：VAYKOR MARELOK）取自于战败的 Grineer 指挥官，并经过重构来提升作战效率和可靠性。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tau/OrokinEmpire/TauDaxAr.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/AntlerBowName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tau/OrokinEmpire/TauDaxAr.descriptionEn: Evoking the design of ancient bows, the high impact Cernos is perfect for hunting down highly shielded enemies.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tau/OrokinEmpire/TauDaxAr.descriptionZh: （英文：CERNOS）这把冲击力强大的西诺斯长弓十分擅长猎杀高护盾的敌人，让人回想起古代长弓的设计。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tau/OrokinEmpire/TauDaxHe.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrnTridentName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tau/OrokinEmpire/TauDaxHe.descriptionEn: Inflict maximum devastation with this massive Grineer trident.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tau/OrokinEmpire/TauDaxHe.descriptionZh: （英文：SYDON）这柄沉重的 Grineer 三叉戟能造成极致的毁灭。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tau/OrokinEmpire/TauDaxKa.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/PangolinSwordName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tau/OrokinEmpire/TauDaxKa.descriptionEn: A unique blade used by an old Tenno clan.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tau/OrokinEmpire/TauDaxKa.descriptionZh: （英文：PANGOLIN SWORD）古老 Tenno 氏族所使用的独特刀刃​​。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tau/OrokinEmpire/TauDaxNi.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/MK1Kunai
/Lotus/Weapons/Tau/OrokinEmpire/TauDaxNi.descriptionEn: The MK1-Kunai is the standard issue throwing knives for all Tenno.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tau/OrokinEmpire/TauDaxNi.descriptionZh: （英文：MK1-KUNAI）MK1-苦无是给Tenno的标准配置投掷武器。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tau/OrokinEmpire/TauDaxPr.name: /Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeSybarisName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tau/OrokinEmpire/TauDaxPr.descriptionEn: Sleek and slender, a golden symbol of Tenno perfection.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tau/OrokinEmpire/TauDaxPr.descriptionZh: （英文：SYBARIS PRIME）纤细而又熠熠生辉，象征着 Tenno 的至善至美。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tau/OrokinEmpire/TauGrine.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrnOrokinRifleWeaponName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tau/OrokinEmpire/TauGrine.descriptionEn: Long before clone-rot set in, elite Grineer Commanders protected the surviving Orokin from rebelling Warframes with these formidable rifles. When Gotva Prime inflicts a Status Effect, its next shot has a chance to be a Super Critical hit.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tau/OrokinEmpire/TauGrine.descriptionZh: （英文：GOTVA PRIME）早在克隆基因衰变之前，精英 Grineer 指挥官就用这把强大的步枪从战甲的叛乱中保护幸存的奥罗金人。当骨葬 Prime 造成异常状态时，下一次射击有机会造成超级暴击。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tau/OrokinEmpire/TauTrapp.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerCombatKnifeName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tau/OrokinEmpire/TauTrapp.descriptionEn: Built for close combat, the Sheev's plasma blade slices through flesh and armor with equal ease.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tau/OrokinEmpire/TauTrapp.descriptionZh: （英文：SHEEV）专为近身战斗设计，希芙的等离子刀刃能轻而易举切开肉体与护甲。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkLexPistols.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/AklexName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkLexPistols.descriptionEn: Dual Lex pistols double the amount of high caliber lead you can throw at the enemy, but accuracy and reload time suffer.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkLexPistols.descriptionZh: （英文：AKLEX）以雷克斯双枪的两只大口径枪管朝敌人开火，但精准度和装填时间会受到负面影响。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkimboAutoPi.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/AkimboAutoPistolName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkimboAutoPi.descriptionEn: Furis pistols equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and slightly faster Fire Rate, but Accuracy and Reload Speed are lowered.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Akimbo/AkimboAutoPi.descriptionZh: （英文：AFURIS）双手各装备一把盗贼手枪，具有两倍的弹匣容量与稍快的射速，但精准度会下降，且换弹的速度增长。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Re.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrnAntiAirGunName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Re.descriptionEn: Shatter your targets with explosive shells from this devastating Archwing cannon.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Re.descriptionZh: （英文：GRATTLER）这把毁灭性的曲翼火炮能发射爆裂弹来击碎你的目标。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Th.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/ThanoTechLongGunName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Th.descriptionEn: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati for use by their Necramechs. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. Punishing automatic primary fire and a secondary mode that charges up to unleash a destructive beam of energy with a large explosion at point of impact.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Archwing/Primary/Th.descriptionZh: （英文：MAUSOLON）英择谛为其殁世机甲所设计的古老武器。主要射击可从目标身上吸取生命精华，以助燃次要射击带来的毁灭性攻击。拥有惩戒性的全自动主要射击。次要模式可在充能后释放一道破坏性能量束，并在作用点造成大范围爆炸。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Beam/SuperMoaBeamWe.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/BeamWeaponName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Beam/SuperMoaBeamWe.descriptionEn: Therma is a short range weapon that deals a constant stream of damage.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Beam/SuperMoaBeamWe.descriptionZh: THERMA 是一把持续输出伤害的短程武器。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/AntlerBow/Antl.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/AntlerBowName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/AntlerBow/Antl.descriptionEn: Evoking the design of ancient bows, the high impact Cernos is perfect for hunting down highly shielded enemies.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/AntlerBow/Antl.descriptionZh: （英文：CERNOS）这把冲击力强大的西诺斯长弓十分擅长猎杀高护盾的敌人，让人回想起古代长弓的设计。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/DaxDuviriAsyme.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/AntlerBowName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/DaxDuviriAsyme.descriptionEn: Evoking the design of ancient bows, the high impact Cernos is perfect for hunting down highly shielded enemies.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/DaxDuviriAsyme.descriptionZh: （英文：CERNOS）这把冲击力强大的西诺斯长弓十分擅长猎杀高护盾的敌人，让人回想起古代长弓的设计。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/StalkerBowAI.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerBowName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/StalkerBowAI.descriptionEn: Dread is the calling card of The Stalker. It fires arrows that can decapitate.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Bows/StalkerBowAI.descriptionZh: （英文：DREAD）恐惧是追猎者的标志性武器，其射出的箭矢足以取人首级。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Grimoire/TnDoppelga.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/GrimoireName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Grimoire/TnDoppelga.descriptionEn: Claim the power of Albrecht Entrati's knowledge. Customize the Grimoire with Tome Mods that enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat. Its alternate attack releases a voltaic orb with guaranteed <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Grimoire/TnDoppelga.descriptionZh: （英文：GRIMOIRE）获取阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的全知之力。使用典籍 Mod 增强战甲技能并获得战术优势。次要射击发射一颗必定造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击异常状态的电弧球。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnBardRifl.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnBardRifleName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnBardRifl.descriptionEn: Unload percussive machine gun fire, or strike a heavy chord with a single charge shot. When Octavia wields her signature rifle alt-fire Headshot Kills have a chance to instantly refill the magazine.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/LongGuns/TnBardRifl.descriptionZh: （英文：TENORA）释放出强大冲击力的机枪炮火，或者用单发充能射击进行重和弦攻击。当 Octavia 使用她的标志性步枪时，由次要射击所造成的爆头击杀有几率立即装填弹匣。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/CronusSword/C.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CronusSwordName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/CronusSword/C.descriptionEn: A strong blade forged using ceramic.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/CronusSword/C.descriptionZh: （英文：CRONUS）一把用陶瓷打造的强大长剑。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Dagger/Dagger.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/HeatDaggerName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Dagger/Dagger.descriptionEn: This short blade weapon has limited range but comes out fast and can inflict fire damage.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Dagger/Dagger.descriptionZh: （英文：HEAT DAGGER）这把短剑攻击范围有限，但挥动速度快，同时可以造成火焰伤害。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/DualDagger/Du.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/DualEtherDaggerName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/DualDagger/Du.descriptionEn: A shorter version of the Ether blade that allows for a more focused attack on a single target.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/DualDagger/Du.descriptionZh: （英文：ETHER DAGGERS）为了强化其对单体攻击而减短苍穹刀身的长度的苍穹。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/DualShortSwor.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/DualShortSwordName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/DualShortSwor.descriptionEn: A shorter Skana in each hand. Can hit multiple targets.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/DualShortSwor.descriptionZh: （英文：DUAL SKANA）每只手拿一把较短的空刃。能同时攻击多个目标。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Gauntlet/Braw.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/BrawlerKnucklesName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Gauntlet/Braw.descriptionEn: These iron fists that rip through foes are Atlas' signature weapons. When wielded by Atlas they receive a Status Chance increase.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Gauntlet/Braw.descriptionZh: （英文：TEKKO）这对铁拳的攻击能撕穿敌人，是 Atlas 的标志性武器。在被 Atlas 使用时，它们的触发几率会提升。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Hammer/Hammer.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/HammerName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Hammer/Hammer.descriptionEn: A large two-handed hammer, the Fragor requires great strength to wield, but impacts with enough force to send groups of enemies tumbling.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Hammer/Hammer.descriptionZh: （英文：FRAGOR）巨大的双手锤，重击巨锤拥有能将复数敌人击飞的力量。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Hammer/IceHam.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/IceHammerName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Hammer/IceHam.descriptionEn: Ice in motion can crush mountains, this frozen hammer is no different.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Hammer/IceHam.descriptionZh: （英文：SIBEAR）冰移可以碾碎山峰，这把冰锤的效果也是一样。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Nunchaku/TnoN.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/TnoNunchakuName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Nunchaku/TnoN.descriptionEn: With these blazing fast nunchaku, the enemy will never know what hit them.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Nunchaku/TnoN.descriptionZh: （英文：SHAKU）这副双节棍挥动速度极快，敌人永远不会知道是被什么武器给击中。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Scythe/EtherS.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/EtherScytheName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Scythe/EtherS.descriptionEn: With a blade forged from the same material as the Ether Sword, the Ether Reaper delivers quick death to its victims.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Scythe/EtherS.descriptionZh: （英文：ETHER REAPER）采用与苍穹之剑相同材质来锻造刀身，让苍穹镰刀迅速的为受害者献上死亡。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Scythe/Nekros.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/ParisScytheName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Scythe/Nekros.descriptionEn: Reap havoc with this full sized Tenno-crafted scythe.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Scythe/Nekros.descriptionZh: （英文：ANKU）带来毁灭与收割生命的制式规格镰刀，由 Tenno 所锻造。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Scythe/ParisS.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/ParisScytheName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Scythe/ParisS.descriptionEn: Reap havoc with this full sized Tenno-crafted scythe.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Scythe/ParisS.descriptionZh: （英文：ANKU）带来毁灭与收割生命的制式规格镰刀，由 Tenno 所锻造。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Scythe/Stalke.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerScytheName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Scythe/Stalke.descriptionEn: Hate is a scythe with a cruel blade, wielded by The Stalker.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Scythe/Stalke.descriptionZh: （英文：HATE）追猎者持有憎恨，这是一把残忍至极的镰刀。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Staff/MonkSpa.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/TnoMonkSpadeName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Staff/MonkSpa.descriptionEn: With its crescent shaped blades flying in sweeping arcs and striking at tremendous speed, the Tipedo demands focus from those wishing to unlock its true power.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Staff/MonkSpa.descriptionZh: （英文：TIPEDO）带有新月型刀刃的提佩多，能以弧形横扫飞舞并以惊人的高速进行攻击。使用者若想释放提佩多的真正威力，必须高度集中精神。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/Cutlas.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/CutlassPoignardName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/Cutlas.descriptionEn: Like the surge and crash of storm waves, a master of the Nami cutlass and Skyla dagger turns these two separate weapons into one fluid attack.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/Cutlas.descriptionZh: （英文：NAMI SKYLA）像暴风雨的汹涌和破坏力一样，精通海波斯库拉对剑的人可以使用这两把不同的武器完成流畅的进攻。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/DaxDuv.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/PangolinSwordName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/DaxDuv.descriptionEn: A unique blade used by an old Tenno clan.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/DaxDuv.descriptionZh: （英文：PANGOLIN SWORD）古老 Tenno 氏族所使用的独特刀刃​​。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/DaxDuv.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/PangolinSwordName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/DaxDuv.descriptionEn: A unique blade used by an old Tenno clan.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/DaxDuv.descriptionZh: （英文：PANGOLIN SWORD）古老 Tenno 氏族所使用的独特刀刃​​。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/DaxDuv.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/PangolinSwordName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/DaxDuv.descriptionEn: A unique blade used by an old Tenno clan.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/DaxDuv.descriptionZh: （英文：PANGOLIN SWORD）古老 Tenno 氏族所使用的独特刀刃​​。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/DaxDuv.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/DaxTwoHandKatanaName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/DaxDuv.descriptionEn: Azothane calls the visionary warrior to turn the tides of battle. Block and melee attack at the same time to plunge Azothane into the ground, damaging nearby enemies with a shockwave and adding to the combo counter.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/DaxDuv.descriptionZh: （英文：AZOTHANE）溶灵尊会召唤出有远见的战士来扭转战局。同时进行格挡和近战攻击来将溶灵尊插入地面，用其冲击波伤害附近的敌人，并增加连击数。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/HeatSw.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/HeatSwordName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/HeatSw.descriptionEn: A strong blade capable of inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage to its foes.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/HeatSw.descriptionZh: （英文：HEAT SWORD）其强力的刀刃能对敌人造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/KrisDa.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/TnoKrisKnifeName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/KrisDa.descriptionEn: Once the blade weapon of choice for an exclusive order of Tenno assassins, the Karyst dagger grew to become a symbol of honor and duty for all Tenno.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/KrisDa.descriptionZh: （英文：KARYST）这曾是一个门第严格的 Tenno 刺客工会的特制武器，凯洛斯特匕首后来渐渐成为了所有 Tenno 的荣耀与使命的象征。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/Plasma.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/PlasmaSwordName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/Plasma.descriptionEn: An advanced blade that delivers high-damage attacks. Delivers a high percentage of critical strikes.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/Plasma.descriptionZh: （英文：PLASMA SWORD）这是一把先进的武器，有着高蓄力伤害和暴击几率。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/Stalke.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/TennoGreatSwordName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/Stalke.descriptionEn: With massive charged power and the ability to hit up to five foes in a single swing, the Galatine sword is the heavy artillery of Melee Weapons.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/Stalke.descriptionZh: （英文：GALATINE）拥有强大蓄气攻击和一次攻击五名敌人的能力，迦伦提恩重剑可称为近身武器中的重炮。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/Stalke.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/StalkerTwoGreatSwordName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/Stalke.descriptionEn: The Stalker's sword as bestowed on him by the Sentient Hunhow.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/Stalke.descriptionZh: （英文：WAR）这把追猎者的剑是 Hunhow 赐予给他的。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/TennoS.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/TennoSaiName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/TennoS.descriptionEn: Perforate enemies with these two needle-sharp sai.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/TennoS.descriptionZh: （英文：OKINA）用这把两端带有尖刺的十手来刺穿敌人。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/TnTwoH.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/TnTwoHandedKatanaName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/TnTwoH.descriptionEn: Fearsome and noble, the elegant two-handed Nikana is the pride of any Arsenal. Kills build charges and seeking projectiles are unleashed with a Slide Attack to find and stun unwitting enemies. When Revenant wields this blade, Tatsu's charge cap is increased.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Swords/TnTwoH.descriptionZh: （英文：TATSU）尊贵而令人畏惧，这把优雅的双手侍刃是任何军械库里的骄傲。击杀可以蓄能，而在施展滑行攻击时，积蓄的能量会转化为投射物，追踪并击晕那些浑然不觉的敌人。在被 Revenant 使用时，龙辰的蓄能次数上限会得到提升。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Tonfa/Boltonf.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/BoltonfaName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Tonfa/Boltonf.descriptionEn: An intimidating Tonfa set designed to match the briary design of the Boltor.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Tonfa/Boltonf.descriptionZh: （英文：BOLTACE）一对设计成与满身尖刺为造型的螺钉步枪相辅相成的拐刃，有着令人生畏的外观。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Warfan/Warfan.name: /Lotus/Language/Weapons/WarfanWeaponName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Warfan/Warfan.descriptionEn: Lacerate attackers with two razor sharp warfans.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Melee/Warfan/Warfan.descriptionZh: （英文：GUNSEN）用两把带有锐利剃刀的军扇来撕碎攻击者。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Pistol/BurstPistol.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/BurstPistolName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Pistol/BurstPistol.descriptionEn: The Sicarus fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of auto-pistols and the accuracy of semi-automatic pistols.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Pistol/BurstPistol.descriptionZh: （英文：SICARUS）暗杀者是三发点射手枪，在连发手枪的杀伤力和单发手枪的准确度之间取得平衡。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Pistol/TutorialPist.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/PistolName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Pistol/TutorialPist.descriptionEn: The Lato is a highly accurate pistol used by the Tenno everywhere.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Pistol/TutorialPist.descriptionZh: （英文：LATO）拉托是一款被 Tenno 广泛使用的高精度手枪。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Pistol/TutorialPist.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/PistolName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Pistol/TutorialPist.descriptionEn: The Lato is a highly accurate pistol used by the Tenno everywhere.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Pistol/TutorialPist.descriptionZh: （英文：LATO）拉托是一款被 Tenno 广泛使用的高精度手枪。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Pistols/AllNew1hSG/.name: /Lotus/Language/Primes/Prime1HShotgunName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Pistols/AllNew1hSG/.descriptionEn: Banshee Prime's signature shotgun is an instrument of devastation that fires both focused and broad shots.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Pistols/AllNew1hSG/.descriptionZh: （英文：EUPHONA PRIME）Banshee Prime 的标志性霰弹枪是把可射出集中和散射子弹的破坏性武器。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Pistols/Magnum/Magn.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/MagnumName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Pistols/Magnum/Magn.descriptionEn: The versatile Magnus revolver is a lethal sidearm for any Tenno.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Pistols/Magnum/Magn.descriptionZh: （英文：MAGNUS）多功能麦格努斯左轮手枪对于任何 Tenno 来说都是一把能置对手于死地的手枪。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/BoltoRifle.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/BoltoRifleName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/BoltoRifle.descriptionEn: The Boltor fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/BoltoRifle.descriptionZh: （英文：BOLTOR）螺钉步枪所发射出的的慢速重型螺钉足以将敌人钉在墙上。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/BurstRifle.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/BurstRifleName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/BurstRifle.descriptionEn: The Burston fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of automatic rifles and the accuracy of semi-automatic rifles.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/BurstRifle.descriptionZh: （英文：BURSTON）伯斯顿是三发点射步枪，在机枪的杀伤力和半自动的准确度之间取得平衡。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/ColonistHeavy.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/HeavyRifleName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/ColonistHeavy.descriptionEn: The Gorgon sports a large magazine that allows it to provide suppressing fire and sustain a high damage rate over a long time. Its high Fire Rate is only achieved following a short wind-up cycle.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/ColonistHeavy.descriptionZh: （英文：GORGON）蛇发女妖是一把重机枪。巨大的弹匣使它能够提供压制火力并长时间维持高伤害率。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/DesertHeavyRi.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/HeavyRifleName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/DesertHeavyRi.descriptionEn: The Gorgon sports a large magazine that allows it to provide suppressing fire and sustain a high damage rate over a long time. Its high Fire Rate is only achieved following a short wind-up cycle.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/DesertHeavyRi.descriptionZh: （英文：GORGON）蛇发女妖是一把重机枪。巨大的弹匣使它能够提供压制火力并长时间维持高伤害率。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/HeavyRifle.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/HeavyRifleName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/HeavyRifle.descriptionEn: The Gorgon sports a large magazine that allows it to provide suppressing fire and sustain a high damage rate over a long time. Its high Fire Rate is only achieved following a short wind-up cycle.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/HeavyRifle.descriptionZh: （英文：GORGON）蛇发女妖是一把重机枪。巨大的弹匣使它能够提供压制火力并长时间维持高伤害率。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/HeavyRifleAI.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/HeavyRifleName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/HeavyRifleAI.descriptionEn: The Gorgon sports a large magazine that allows it to provide suppressing fire and sustain a high damage rate over a long time. Its high Fire Rate is only achieved following a short wind-up cycle.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/HeavyRifleAI.descriptionZh: （英文：GORGON）蛇发女妖是一把重机枪。巨大的弹匣使它能够提供压制火力并长时间维持高伤害率。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/HeavyRifleAIM.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/HeavyRifleName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/HeavyRifleAIM.descriptionEn: The Gorgon sports a large magazine that allows it to provide suppressing fire and sustain a high damage rate over a long time. Its high Fire Rate is only achieved following a short wind-up cycle.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/HeavyRifleAIM.descriptionZh: （英文：GORGON）蛇发女妖是一把重机枪。巨大的弹匣使它能够提供压制火力并长时间维持高伤害率。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/SemiAutoRifle.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/SemiAutoRifleName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/SemiAutoRifle.descriptionEn: The Latron is a highly efficient rifle that performs well at medium and at long range, its accuracy making it a deadly weapon in the hands of skilled marksmen.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/SemiAutoRifle.descriptionZh: （英文：LATRON）拉特昂是一支半自动步枪。其高性能和高准确性令它在一名能精准射击的人手中时可以变得十分致命。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/VIPRifle.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/VIPRifleName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/VIPRifle.descriptionEn: A special version of the standard Braton rifle with a slower Fire Rate but offering higher accuracy and damage values. The Braton Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the grips.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Rifle/VIPRifle.descriptionZh: （英文：BRATON VANDAL）布莱顿的特别版本，有着较低的射速，但更高的精准度和伤害。布莱顿·破坏者被 Tenno 定制成蓝绿色金属光泽，并在握把上绘制了 Lotus 纹样。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/DecoyShotgu.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/ShotgunName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/DecoyShotgu.descriptionEn: The Strun is a standard shotgun. Reliable, versatile and deadly.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/DecoyShotgu.descriptionZh: （英文：STRUN）斯特朗是一把标准的霰弹枪，可靠，灵活，致命。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/EidolonEvis.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerDoubleBarrellName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/EidolonEvis.descriptionEn: Sobek is a rapid-firing Grineer shotgun that has reduced damage per shot but boasts extra large magazine capacity.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/EidolonEvis.descriptionZh: （英文：SOBEK）鳄神是一把速射型 Grineer 霰弹枪，虽降低每一枪的伤害，但拥有超大弹匣容量。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/EviseratorW.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerDoubleBarrellName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/EviseratorW.descriptionEn: Sobek is a rapid-firing Grineer shotgun that has reduced damage per shot but boasts extra large magazine capacity.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/EviseratorW.descriptionZh: （英文：SOBEK）鳄神是一把速射型 Grineer 霰弹枪，虽降低每一枪的伤害，但拥有超大弹匣容量。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/FortressEvi.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/GrineerDoubleBarrellName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/FortressEvi.descriptionEn: Sobek is a rapid-firing Grineer shotgun that has reduced damage per shot but boasts extra large magazine capacity.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/FortressEvi.descriptionZh: （英文：SOBEK）鳄神是一把速射型 Grineer 霰弹枪，虽降低每一枪的伤害，但拥有超大弹匣容量。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/FortressQua.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/QuadShotgunName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/FortressQua.descriptionEn: The Hek is a powerful shotgun that fires its shots with a tight spread, making it efficient at medium range as long as its strong recoil is properly managed.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/FortressQua.descriptionZh: （英文：HEK）海克是一把能发射密集弹丸的强力霰弹枪，只要能驾驭其猛烈后坐力，在中距离战斗也能有效发挥。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/FullAutoSho.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/AutoShotgunName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/FullAutoSho.descriptionEn: A shotgun with low accuracy and strong recoil, but able to deliver its payload in full-auto. The Boar is best used at close range.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/FullAutoSho.descriptionZh: （英文：BOAR）野猪有着较低的精度和大后坐力，但可以全自动发射载弹。最适宜近距离使用。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/QuadShotgun.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/QuadShotgunName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/QuadShotgun.descriptionEn: The Hek is a powerful shotgun that fires its shots with a tight spread, making it efficient at medium range as long as its strong recoil is properly managed.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/QuadShotgun.descriptionZh: （英文：HEK）海克是一把能发射密集弹丸的强力霰弹枪，只要能驾驭其猛烈后坐力，在中距离战斗也能有效发挥。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/Shotgun.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/ShotgunName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/Shotgun.descriptionEn: The Strun is a standard shotgun. Reliable, versatile and deadly.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Shotgun/Shotgun.descriptionZh: （英文：STRUN）斯特朗是一把标准的霰弹枪，可靠，灵活，致命。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/ThrowingWeapons/Kun.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/KunaiName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/ThrowingWeapons/Kun.descriptionEn: Kunai throwing daggers offer a silent alternative to the traditional side arm. Perfect for assassins.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/ThrowingWeapons/Kun.descriptionZh: （英文：KUNAI）苦无以投掷用匕首替代传统次要武器的非静音攻击。暗杀首选。

/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/ThrowingWeapons/Ten.name: /Lotus/Language/Items/TennoShurikenName
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/ThrowingWeapons/Ten.descriptionEn: As an alternative to Kunai, these Tenno throwing stars do cause less Damage but they come with expanded Ammo Capacity and a higher Fire Rate.
/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/ThrowingWeapons/Ten.descriptionZh: （英文：HIKOU）作为苦无的替代方案，飞扬用较低的伤害换得更高的携带量跟更快的射速。
